docs.title: Layer 1: MT4Account (Low-Level) — You are here!
docs.text:
What: direct proto/gRPC communication with the MT4 terminal.

When to use: - You need full control over the protocol - You are building custom wrappers - Proto-level integration is required

Characteristics: - Works with proto *Request / *Data objects - Raw gRPC method calls - Complete access to all MT4 functions - Highest complexity

Location: include/metarpc/mt4_account.hpp + src/mt4_account.cpp (on top of the gRPC stubs generated at build time from proto/mt4_term_api.desc into build/generated/)

Documentation: this folder (you are here!)

docs.title: Layer 2: MT4Service
docs.text:
What: a friendly facade over MT4Account — clean arguments, friendly C++ structs, times in UTC. Its header is protobuf-free, so strategy code compiles fast.

When to use: - You want a clean API without touching protobuf - You want named struct fields instead of proto getters - You want times already converted to UTC

Location: include/metarpc/mt4_service.hpp + src/mt4_service.cpp

docs.title: Layer 3: MT4Sugar
docs.text:
What: high-level convenience API with ~62 one-liner methods.

When to use: - Most trading scenarios (95% of cases) - You want risk-based position sizing and smart defaults - You are building strategies quickly

Location: include/metarpc/mt4_sugar.hpp + src/mt4_sugar.cpp

docs.title: 🎓 Learning Path
docs.text:
Recommended sequence: start from the foundation (MT4Account) → build up to the convenience layers (MT4Service → MT4Sugar).

Each layer owns the one below it: MT4Sugar owns an MT4Service, which owns an MT4Account. From Sugar you can always reach down with sugar.service() and sugar.account().

Summary: MT4Account (foundation) → MT4Service (friendly facade) → MT4Sugar (one-liners).

docs.title: MQL4 trade error codes (thrown as ApiError)
docs.text:
MT4 trades have no success return code — a rejection throws ApiError whose mqlErrorCode is the MQL4 error:

  • 0 = no error
  • 130 = invalid stops (SL/TP too close to market)
  • 131 = invalid trade volume
  • 132 = market closed
  • 133 = trade disabled
  • 134 = not enough money
  • 135 = price changed
  • 136 = off quotes
  • 138 = requote
  • 146 = trade context busy

Catch ApiError around every trade call and inspect e.mqlErrorCode / e.what().

docs.title: ⚠️ Important Notes
docs.text:
• Demo account first: always test on demo before live trading.
  • Trades throw on rejection: there is no retcode — wrap orderSend/orderModify/orderCloseDelete in try/catch (const ApiError&).
  • Orders, not positions: openedOrders() returns market and pending orders together — tell them apart by order_type().
  • Handle errors: catch ApiError (server rejected the request) and TransportError (network/transport failed past retries).
  • Stream cleanup: call stop() on the stream handle, and keep the handle alive while you need events.
  • Time zones: raw-layer messages carry both a server-time field and a _utc field; the MT4Service layer selects UTC for you.
  • Broker limitations: not all brokers support every symbol/feature; a symbol must be in Market Watch (symbolSelect) before it streams or trades.

"Trade safe, code clean, and may your gRPC streams always flow smoothly."

docs.title: ✅ Getting an Account Summary
docs.text:
Request: full account summary (AccountSummaryData) from MT4. Fetch all core account metrics in a single call.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::accountSummary(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: AccountSummary (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: AccountSummary(AccountSummaryRequest) → AccountSummaryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::AccountSummary(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A single RPC returning full account state: balance, equity, credit, currency, leverage, trade mode, margin / free margin / margin level / margin mode, trade flags, and server time.
  • Why you need it. Fast dashboard/CLI status; double-check login/currency/leverage; pre-trade affordability; connection heartbeat via server_time().
  • Sanity check. If you see account_login(), account_currency(), account_leverage(), account_equity() → the connection is alive.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it to display real-time account state and sanity-check connectivity:

  • Dashboard/CLI status in one call.
  • Verify balance & equity before trading.
  • Terminal heartbeat via server_time() / server_time_utc() and server_utc_offset_seconds().
  • First call also primes the broker-time offset the SDK caches for serverOffsetSeconds().

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Retrieves full account information in a single call.
    // Returns AccountSummaryData with balance, equity, leverage, currency and
    // other account properties. Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::AccountSummaryData accountSummary(const pb::AccountSummaryRequest& req = {});
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

AccountSummaryRequest {} (empty message — just pass the default)

Reply message:

AccountSummaryReply {
  oneof response {
    AccountSummaryData data  = 1;
    Error              error = 2;
  }
}

MT4Account unwraps the oneof: it returns data on success and throws ApiError (carrying the server-side Error) otherwise.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description req const pb::AccountSummaryRequest& Empty request message. Optional — defaults to {}.

There is no ctx parameter. The per-call deadline comes from ClientOptions. Tune it on the account:

account.options().unaryTimeoutMs = 5000;   // deadline for ordinary read RPCs (default 30000)
account.options().maxRetries     = 5;       // transient-failure / reconnect retry budget

Each call runs on a background deadline; on UNAVAILABLE / DEADLINE_EXCEEDED it is retried with exponential back-off, and a dropped terminal session is re-attached automatically before the retry.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — AccountSummaryData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description account_login account_login() int64_t Trading account login (ID). account_balance account_balance() double Balance excluding floating P/L. account_equity account_equity() double Equity = balance + floating P/L. account_user_name account_user_name() const std::string& Account holder name. account_leverage account_leverage() int64_t Leverage (e.g., 100 for 1:100). account_trade_mode account_trade_mode() EnumAccountTradeMode Demo / Contest / Real — see enum below. account_company_name account_company_name() const std::string& Broker/company display name. account_currency account_currency() const std::string& Deposit currency (e.g., "USD"). server_time server_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Server time at response, in the broker's time zone. server_time_utc server_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp The same moment as server_time(), in UTC. account_credit account_credit() double Credit amount. is_investor is_investor() bool true when connected with a read-only (investor) password. utc_server_time_shift_minutes utc_server_time_shift_minutes() int32_t Server offset relative to UTC (minutes). server_utc_offset_seconds server_utc_offset_seconds() int32_t Broker server's offset from UTC in seconds (positive = ahead of UTC). account_margin account_margin() double Margin currently used by open orders. account_margin_free account_margin_free() double Free margin available for new orders. account_margin_level account_margin_level() double Margin level in percent (equity / margin × 100); 0 when no margin is used. account_margin_mode account_margin_mode() EnumAccountMarginMode Margin mode — see enum below. account_trade_allowed account_trade_allowed() bool Trading allowed for this account. account_trade_expert account_trade_expert() bool Automated (Expert Advisor) trading allowed.

C++ protobuf accessors are snake_case and return the value by reference for strings/messages, by value for scalars.

🧮 Floating profit: MT4's summary has no dedicated profit field — compute account_equity() - account_balance().

docs.title: 🧱 Related enums (from proto)
docs.text: 💡 Enum Usage Note: in C++ the generated enum values live at namespace scope (they are not enum class), so you write pb::ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO, not a prefixed form.

docs.title: EnumAccountTradeMode
docs.text:
Defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto:

enum EnumAccountTradeMode {
  ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO    = 0;  // demo/practice
  ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_CONTEST = 1;  // contest
  ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_REAL    = 2;  // real trading
}

Helper to convert the enum to a string:

const char* tradeModeToString(pb::EnumAccountTradeMode m) {
    switch (m) {
        case pb::ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO:    return "DEMO";
        case pb::ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_CONTEST: return "CONTEST";
        case pb::ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_REAL:    return "REAL";
        default:                             return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}

docs.title: EnumAccountMarginMode
docs.text:
enum EnumAccountMarginMode {
  ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_NETTING = 0;  // netting (one position per symbol)
  ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_EXCHANGE       = 1;  // exchange margin
  ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_HEDGING = 2;  // hedging (multiple orders per symbol) — typical MT4
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Automatic reconnection: every MT4Account method runs through an internal call<> wrapper that retries transient gRPC errors and re-attaches a dropped terminal session (TERMINAL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND) before retrying.
  • Default timeout: read RPCs use ClientOptions::unaryTimeoutMs (default 30000 ms).
  • Errors are exceptions: a server-side rejection throws metarpc::ApiError; a transport failure past the retry budget throws metarpc::TransportError. There are no error return values.
  • Timestamps: server_time() / server_time_utc() are google.protobuf.Timestamp; read .seconds() for epoch seconds, or use the friendly MT4Service::accountSummary() which returns UTC fields already converted.
  • Investor mode: if is_investor() is true, read calls work but trading will be rejected by the broker.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();

    std::printf("Account Login: %lld\n", (long long)s.account_login());
    std::printf("Balance: %.2f %s\n", s.account_balance(), s.account_currency().c_str());
    std::printf("Equity: %.2f\n", s.account_equity());
    std::printf("Leverage: 1:%lld\n", (long long)s.account_leverage());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Compact status line for a CLI
docs.text:
void printAccountStatus(MT4Account& account) {
    try {
        pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
        std::printf("Acc %lld | %s | Bal %.2f | Eq %.2f | Lev 1:%lld | Mode %s\n",
                    (long long)s.account_login(),
                    s.account_currency().c_str(),
                    s.account_balance(),
                    s.account_equity(),
                    (long long)s.account_leverage(),
                    tradeModeToString(s.account_trade_mode()));
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::printf("❌ Error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
}
// Output: Acc 1235959737 | USD | Bal 99485.00 | Eq 99339.60 | Lev 1:100 | Mode DEMO

docs.title: 3) Floating profit + margin health
docs.text:
void printHealth(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
    double floating = s.account_equity() - s.account_balance();   // MT4 has no profit field
    double level    = s.account_margin_level();                   // 0 when flat

    std::printf("Floating P/L: %.2f\n", floating);
    if (level == 0)          std::puts("No open margin");
    else if (level < 100)    std::puts("⚠️ Margin level critical!");
    else if (level < 200)    std::puts("⚠️ Low margin level");
    else                     std::puts("✅ Healthy margin level");
}

docs.title: 4) Server time with timezone shift
docs.text:
#include <ctime>

void printServerTime(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();

    std::time_t utc    = (std::time_t)s.server_time_utc().seconds();
    std::time_t broker = (std::time_t)s.server_time().seconds();

    char buf[32];
    std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::gmtime(&utc));
    std::printf("Server time (UTC): %s\n", buf);
    std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::gmtime(&broker));
    std::printf("Server time (broker): %s\n", buf);
    std::printf("Broker offset from UTC: %+d seconds (%d min)\n",
                s.server_utc_offset_seconds(), s.utc_server_time_shift_minutes());
}

docs.title: 5) Tightening the deadline for one account
docs.text:
MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
account.options().unaryTimeoutMs = 2000;   // fail fast after 2 s
account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

try {
    pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
    std::printf("Balance: %.2f\n", s.account_balance());
} catch (const TransportError& e) {
    std::printf("Timed out / transport error: %s\n", e.what());
}

docs.title: 6) Structured data model
docs.text:
// A clean plain struct for UI / business logic
struct AccountSummaryView {
    int64_t      login;
    std::string  currency;
    double       balance;
    double       equity;
    double       floating;    // equity - balance
    int64_t      leverage;
    std::string  tradeMode;
    std::string  company;
};

AccountSummaryView fromProto(const pb::AccountSummaryData& d) {
    return AccountSummaryView{
        d.account_login(),
        d.account_currency(),
        d.account_balance(),
        d.account_equity(),
        d.account_equity() - d.account_balance(),
        d.account_leverage(),
        tradeModeToString(d.account_trade_mode()),
        d.account_company_name(),
    };
}

// Usage:
AccountSummaryView v = fromProto(account.accountSummary());
std::printf("%lld %s %.2f (float %.2f)\n",
            (long long)v.login, v.currency.c_str(), v.balance, v.floating);

docs.title: 7) Error handling (reconnect is automatic)
docs.text:
bool tryGetSummary(MT4Account& account, pb::AccountSummaryData& out) {
    try {
        out = account.accountSummary();   // transient errors already retried inside
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Server rejected the request: %s\n", e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport failed after retries: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Health check
docs.text:
bool isAccountHealthy(MT4Account& account) {
    try {
        pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
        return s.account_login() > 0 &&
               !s.account_currency().empty() &&
               s.account_leverage() > 0;
    } catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
}

docs.title: Monitor account changes
docs.text:
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>

void monitorAccount(MT4Account& account, std::chrono::seconds interval) {
    for (;;) {
        try {
            pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
            std::printf("Balance: %.2f | Equity: %.2f | Float: %.2f\n",
                        s.account_balance(), s.account_equity(),
                        s.account_equity() - s.account_balance());
        } catch (const std::exception& e) {
            std::printf("❌ Error: %s\n", e.what());
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(interval);
    }
}
// Usage: monitorAccount(account, std::chrono::seconds(5));

docs.title: MT4Account · Account Information — Overview
docs.text:
The account's money picture and trading analytics: a one-call snapshot (balance, equity, margin, leverage, currency, trade mode, server time), aggregated performance stats, the equity curve, and the per-order floating-P&L extrema.

These methods are read-only. accountSummary lives on mt4_term_api.AccountHelper; the four analytics methods live on mt4_term_api.TradeStats. Each returns a typed *Data payload.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• AccountSummary — all account info at once (login, balance, equity, credit, leverage, currency, margin / free margin / margin level / margin mode, trade flags, server time and its UTC offset). Returns the EnumAccountTradeMode and EnumAccountMarginMode enums.
  • TradeStats — aggregated performance statistics (profit factor, win rate, drawdowns, Sharpe, …) over an optional time window.
  • TradeStatsEquityHistory — the same stats plus equity-curve points and the per-trade series, in one call.
  • EquityHistory — just the balance/equity-curve points (lighter than the combined call).
  • TradeUnrealizedPL — the max/min floating P&L each open order has reached.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• AccountSummary → the one-stop shop for a complete account snapshot. One RPC, everything you need for a dashboard, a pre-trade affordability check, or a connection heartbeat.
  • TradeStats → the performance report — how your closed trades actually did.
  • EquityHistory / TradeStatsEquityHistory → the equity curve — draw it alone, or get it bundled with the stats.
  • TradeUnrealizedPL → how far each open trade has swung into profit/loss while it was running.

🆚 MT4 vs MT5: MT5 also offers accountInfoDouble/Integer/String to read a single property by enum id. MT4 has none of those — the AccountHelper service exposes only AccountSummary, which already carries every field, so there is nothing lighter to call. Want just the balance? Read account_balance() off the summary. And unlike MT5, this AccountSummaryData does carry margin / free-margin / margin-level directly.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text:
If you need… Use Returns Enums used Complete account snapshot (all values) accountSummary AccountSummaryData Output: EnumAccountTradeMode, EnumAccountMarginMode Performance report (win rate, drawdown, PF) tradeStats StatsData — Stats and the equity curve in one call tradeStatsEquityHistory StatsWithChartsData — Just the equity-curve points equityHistory EquityHistoryData — How far each open trade swung tradeUnrealizedPL TradeUnrealizedPLData —

The stats requests all accept an optional from (broker server time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss) or from_utc — send one, not both; omit both for the full account history.

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Margin — accountSummary() already returns account_margin(), account_margin_free(), account_margin_level() and account_margin_mode(). There is no single-property getter on MT4.
  • Floating profit — unlike MT5, MT4's summary does not expose a dedicated profit field; compute it as account_equity() - account_balance() (that is exactly what MT4Sugar::getProfit() does). For the per-order floating extrema, use tradeUnrealizedPL.
  • Investor password — is_investor() is true when you connected with a read-only (investor) password; trading calls will then be rejected by the broker.
  • Server time — server_time() is the broker's clock; server_time_utc() is the same instant in UTC, and utc_server_time_shift_minutes() / server_utc_offset_seconds() give the offset. The first accountSummary() is also what the SDK uses to learn and cache the broker offset for MT4Account::serverOffsetSeconds().
  • commission is misspelled on the wire — StatsData exposes it as comissions() (one “m”), matching the generated protobuf accessor.
  • Timeout — read RPCs use ClientOptions::unaryTimeoutMs (default 30000 ms); tune with account.options().

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippet
docs.text:
// Complete account snapshot
pb::AccountSummaryData s = account.accountSummary();
std::printf("Balance: %.2f %s, Equity: %.2f, Leverage: 1:%lld\n",
            s.account_balance(), s.account_currency().c_str(),
            s.account_equity(), (long long)s.account_leverage());

// Performance over the whole account history
pb::StatsRequest sreq;                         // no `from` → full history
pb::StatsData st = account.tradeStats(sreq);
std::printf("Profit factor: %.2f, Win rate: %.1f%%\n",
            st.profit_factor(), st.win_rate() * 100.0);

docs.title: Output enums (return values)
📝 Important notes about enums
docs.text:
• Namespace-scope values — in C++ the generated values are not enum class; write pb::ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO, pb::ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_NETTING.
  • MT4 enum names are un-prefixed — note these are EnumAccountTradeMode / EnumAccountMarginMode (no Mrpc… prefix as on MT5).

docs.title: 1) Basic — print the curve
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::EquityHistoryData h = account.equityHistory(pb::EquityHistoryRequest{});
    for (const auto& p : h.points()) {
        std::time_t t = (std::time_t)p.time_utc().seconds();
        char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d", std::gmtime(&t));
        std::printf("%s  bal %.2f  eq %.2f\n", buf, p.balance(), p.equity());
    }
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Peak equity and max drawdown
docs.text:
void maxDrawdown(const pb::EquityHistoryData& h) {
    double peak = 0, maxDD = 0, maxDDpct = 0;
    for (const auto& p : h.points()) {
        peak = std::max(peak, p.equity());
        double dd = peak - p.equity();
        if (dd > maxDD) { maxDD = dd; maxDDpct = peak > 0 ? dd / peak * 100 : 0; }
    }
    std::printf("Peak %.2f  max DD %.2f (%.1f%%)\n", peak, maxDD, maxDDpct);
}

docs.title: 3) Net realized P/L (last point)
docs.text:
double realizedToDate(const pb::EquityHistoryData& h) {
    return h.points_size() ? h.points(h.points_size() - 1).realized_pl() : 0.0;
}

docs.title: 4) Export to CSV
docs.text:
#include <fstream>
void toCsv(const pb::EquityHistoryData& h, const std::string& path) {
    std::ofstream f(path);
    f << "time_utc,balance,equity,equity_dd\n";
    for (const auto& p : h.points())
        f << p.time_utc().seconds() << ',' << p.balance() << ','
          << p.equity() << ',' << p.equity_drawdown_relative() << '\n';
}

docs.title: Min/max equity window
docs.text:
std::pair<double,double> equityRange(const pb::EquityHistoryData& h) {
    double lo = 1e18, hi = -1e18;
    for (const auto& p : h.points()) { lo = std::min(lo, p.equity()); hi = std::max(hi, p.equity()); }
    return { lo, hi };
}

Single “m”. sharpe_ratio sharpe_ratio() double Sharpe ratio. standard_deviation standard_deviation() double Std-dev of returns. ghpr ghpr() double Geometric holding-period return. growth_percent growth_percent() double Account growth (%). max_balance_drawdown_raw max_balance_drawdown_raw() double Max balance drawdown (money). max_balance_drawdown_relative max_balance_drawdown_relative() double Max balance drawdown (%). max_equity_drawdown_raw max_equity_drawdown_raw() double Max equity drawdown (money). max_equity_drawdown_relative max_equity_drawdown_relative() double Max equity drawdown (%). deposits deposits() double Total deposits. withdrawals withdrawals() double Total withdrawals.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• String dates. from / from_utc are ISO-8601 strings ("2026-01-01T00:00:00") — not protobuf Timestamp.
  • Server-computed. No need to pull history and recompute — this is the terminal's own report.
  • Spelling quirks. comissions() (one m), tiket(), won_persent() are proto typos frozen into the contract.
  • Win rate = profitability().won_trades_percent().
  • Reconnection is automatic.

#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

const char* verdict(const pb::StatsData& s) {
    if (s.trades() == 0)        return "no trades yet";
    if (s.profit_factor() >= 1.5) return "strong";
    if (s.profit_factor() >= 1.0) return "profitable";
    return "losing";

struct Report { double pf; int64_t trades; int points; double maxDD; };
Report buildReport(const pb::StatsWithChartsData& d) {
    double peak = 0, maxDD = 0;
    for (const auto& p : d.charts()) { peak = std::max(peak, p.equity()); maxDD = std::max(maxDD, peak - p.equity()); }

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Open orders only — this tracks extrema for live orders; closed trades are in OrdersHistory.
  • MAE/MFE — pair with the current profit() to see how much of the peak is left, or how far underwater it went.
  • String dates — from / from_utc are ISO-8601 strings (not Timestamp).
  • ticket is int64 here (the stats service uses 64-bit tickets), whereas live-order tickets are int32.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic — MFE/MAE per order
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::TradeUnrealizedPLData d = account.tradeUnrealizedPL(pb::TradeUnrealizedPLRequest{});
    for (const auto& e : d.extrema())
        std::printf("#%lld %-8s  MFE %.2f  MAE %.2f\n",
                    (long long)e.ticket(), e.symbol().c_str(),
                    e.max_unrealized_pl(), e.min_unrealized_pl());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Profit given back from the peak
docs.text:
// pair extrema with current profit from openedOrders()
#include <map>
void givebacks(MT4Account& account) {
    std::map<int, double> peak;
    for (const auto& e : account.tradeUnrealizedPL(pb::TradeUnrealizedPLRequest{}).extrema())
        peak[(int)e.ticket()] = e.max_unrealized_pl();
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        auto it = peak.find(o.ticket());
        if (it != peak.end())
            std::printf("#%d gave back %.2f from peak\n", o.ticket(), it->second - o.profit());
    }
}

docs.title: 3) Worst heat taken (biggest MAE)
docs.text:
void worstHeat(const pb::TradeUnrealizedPLData& d) {
    const pb::TradeUnrealizedExtremaData* worst = nullptr;
    for (const auto& e : d.extrema())
        if (!worst || e.min_unrealized_pl() < worst->min_unrealized_pl()) worst = &e;
    if (worst) std::printf("worst heat: #%lld %s MAE %.2f\n",
                           (long long)worst->ticket(), worst->symbol().c_str(), worst->min_unrealized_pl());
}

docs.title: 4) When each peak happened
docs.text:
#include <ctime>
void peakTimes(const pb::TradeUnrealizedPLData& d) {
    for (const auto& e : d.extrema()) {
        std::time_t t = (std::time_t)e.max_unrealized_time_utc().seconds();
        char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", std::gmtime(&t));
        std::printf("#%lld peak %.2f @ %s UTC\n", (long long)e.ticket(), e.max_unrealized_pl(), buf);
    }
}

docs.title: 5) Orders still underwater (MFE ≤ 0)
docs.text:
void neverGreen(const pb::TradeUnrealizedPLData& d) {
    for (const auto& e : d.extrema())
        if (e.max_unrealized_pl() <= 0)
            std::printf("#%lld %s never went positive\n", (long long)e.ticket(), e.symbol().c_str());
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryUnrealized(MT4Account& account, pb::TradeUnrealizedPLData& out) {
    try { out = account.tradeUnrealizedPL(pb::TradeUnrealizedPLRequest{}); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Trade-quality score (kept fraction of peak)
docs.text:
#include <map>
void keptFraction(MT4Account& account) {
    std::map<int, double> peak;
    for (const auto& e : account.tradeUnrealizedPL(pb::TradeUnrealizedPLRequest{}).extrema())
        peak[(int)e.ticket()] = e.max_unrealized_pl();
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        auto it = peak.find(o.ticket());
        if (it != peak.end() && it->second > 0)
            std::printf("#%d kept %.0f%% of peak\n", o.ticket(), 100.0 * o.profit() / it->second);
    }
}

docs.title: 📋 Listing All Open Orders
docs.text:
Request: every live order (OpenedOrdersData) from MT4 — market and pending, in one list, with full per-order detail.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::openedOrders(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrders (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OpenedOrders(OpenedOrdersRequest) → OpenedOrdersReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::OpenedOrders(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning all live orders — both market trades (OO_OP_BUY / OO_OP_SELL) and pending orders (OO_OP_BUYLIMIT … OO_OP_SELLSTOP) — in a single repeated list.
  • Why you need it. Draw a positions/orders blotter, sum floating P/L, find orders by symbol or magic number, feed a trailing-stop or risk manager.
  • Sanity check. order_infos_size() is the order count; each entry has a non-zero ticket() and a symbol().

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it whenever you need the current order book of the account:

  • A live blotter / dashboard of everything that is open.
  • Compute net floating P/L (sum of profit()), exposure per symbol, or lots by side.
  • Locate the orders a strategy owns (filter by magic_number()), then modify or close them.
  • Remember: MT4 has no "positions" — this is the complete picture of open exposure and working orders.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Returns all live orders (market + pending) in one call.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::OpenedOrdersData openedOrders(const pb::OpenedOrdersRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OpenedOrdersRequest {
  EnumOpenedOrderSortType sort_type = 1;   // order of the returned list
}

sort_type defaults to SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_ASC (0). Pass the default-constructed request for the natural order.

Reply message:

OpenedOrdersReply {
  oneof response {
    OpenedOrdersData data  = 1;
    Error            error = 2;
  }
}

MT4Account unwraps the oneof: it returns data on success and throws ApiError otherwise.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description order_infos order_infos() RepeatedPtrField<OpenedOrderInfo> All live orders. Use order_infos_size() / range-for.

docs.title: OpenedOrderInfo (one order)
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description ticket ticket() int32_t Order ticket (unique id). int32 on MT4. symbol symbol() const std::string& Instrument, e.g. "EURUSD". order_type order_type() OpenedOrderType Buy/Sell (market) or Limit/Stop (pending) — see enum. lots lots() double Volume in lots. open_price open_price() double Entry price (for pending: the trigger price). stop_loss stop_loss() double SL price (0 = none). take_profit take_profit() double TP price (0 = none). profit profit() double Current floating P/L of this order (broker-calculated). swap swap() double Accrued swap. commision (sic) commision() double Commission charged. Note the single “m”. magic_number magic_number() int32_t EA/strategy tag set at send time. comment comment() const std::string& Order comment. open_time open_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time, broker clock. open_time_utc open_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time, UTC. expiration_time expiration_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Pending-order expiry (broker clock); unset for market. expiration_time_utc expiration_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Expiry, UTC. account_login account_login() int64_t Owning account login. position_index position_index() int32_t Internal ordering index. sort_index sort_index() int32_t Index under the requested sort_type.

🧮 Net floating P/L: Σ order.profit() over the list equals equity − balance from AccountSummary.

docs.title: OpenedOrderType
docs.text:
enum OpenedOrderType {
  OO_OP_BUY = 0; OO_OP_SELL = 1;            // market
  OO_OP_BUYLIMIT = 2; OO_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;  // pending limit
  OO_OP_BUYSTOP = 4; OO_OP_SELLSTOP = 5;    // pending stop
  OO_OP_BALANCE = 6; OO_OP_CREDIT = 7;      // non-trade (mostly in history)
}

inline bool isPending(pb::OpenedOrderType t) {
    return t >= pb::OO_OP_BUYLIMIT && t <= pb::OO_OP_SELLSTOP;
}
inline bool isBuy(pb::OpenedOrderType t) {
    return t == pb::OO_OP_BUY || t == pb::OO_OP_BUYLIMIT || t == pb::OO_OP_BUYSTOP;
}

docs.title: EnumOpenedOrderSortType (request)
docs.text:
enum EnumOpenedOrderSortType {
  SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_ASC = 0; SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_DESC = 1;
  SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_ASC = 2; SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_DESC = 3;
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• One list, two kinds. Market and pending orders share the list; always branch on order_type() before treating a row as an open trade.
  • Commission spelling. It is commision() on the wire — a protobuf field typo that cannot be changed without breaking the contract.
  • Empty is normal. A flat account returns order_infos_size() == 0, not an error.
  • Reconnection is automatic. Like all reads, this runs through the retry/reconnect wrapper.
  • Timestamps. open_time() etc. are google.protobuf.Timestamp; read .seconds() or use MT4Service::openedOrders() for ready UTC fields.

docs.title: 1) Basic listing
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    std::printf("Open orders: %d\n", oo.order_infos_size());
    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos())
        std::printf("  #%d %-8s %.2f @ %.5f  P/L %.2f\n",
                    o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str(), o.lots(),
                    o.open_price(), o.profit());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Split market vs pending
docs.text:
void splitOrders(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    int market = 0, pending = 0;
    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos())
        (isPending(o.order_type()) ? pending : market)++;
    std::printf("Market: %d   Pending: %d\n", market, pending);
}

docs.title: 3) Net floating P/L and exposure per symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>

void exposure(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    double floating = 0;
    std::map<std::string, double> lotsBySymbol;
    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos()) {
        if (isPending(o.order_type())) continue;     // only market exposure
        floating += o.profit() + o.swap() + o.commision();
        lotsBySymbol[o.symbol()] += isBuy(o.order_type()) ? o.lots() : -o.lots();
    }
    std::printf("Net floating (incl. swap/comm): %.2f\n", floating);
    for (auto& [sym, net] : lotsBySymbol)
        std::printf("  %-8s net %.2f lots\n", sym.c_str(), net);
}

docs.title: 4) Find orders owned by a strategy (magic number)
docs.text:
std::vector<int32_t> ticketsForMagic(MT4Account& account, int32_t magic) {
    std::vector<int32_t> out;
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos())
        if (o.magic_number() == magic) out.push_back(o.ticket());
    return out;
}

docs.title: 5) Newest first, with time
docs.text:
#include <ctime>

void recentFirst(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::OpenedOrdersRequest req;
    req.set_sort_type(pb::SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_DESC);
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(req);

    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos()) {
        std::time_t t = (std::time_t)o.open_time_utc().seconds();
        char buf[20];
        std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", std::gmtime(&t));
        std::printf("[%s UTC] #%d %s %.2f\n",
                    buf, o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str(), o.lots());
    }
}

docs.title: 6) Orders at risk (no stop-loss)
docs.text:
void unprotected(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos())
        if (!isPending(o.order_type()) && o.stop_loss() == 0.0)
            std::printf("⚠️ #%d %s has NO stop-loss\n",
                        o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str());
}

docs.title: 7) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryGetOrders(MT4Account& account, pb::OpenedOrdersData& out) {
    try {
        out = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport failed after retries: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Count orders by symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>
std::map<std::string,int> countBySymbol(MT4Account& account) {
    std::map<std::string,int> m;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos())
        m[o.symbol()]++;
    return m;
}

docs.title: Poll tickets cheaply, pull details only on change
docs.text:
// Prefer openedOrdersTickets() to detect changes, then openedOrders() for detail.
static std::vector<int32_t> prev;
auto t = account.openedOrdersTickets(pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest{});
std::vector<int32_t> now(t.tickets().begin(), t.tickets().end());
if (now != prev) {
    prev = now;
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    /* refresh the blotter … */
}

docs.title: 🎟️ Listing Open Order Tickets
docs.text:
Request: just the ticket numbers of all live orders (OpenedOrdersTicketsData) from MT4 — the lightweight counterpart of OpenedOrders.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::openedOrdersTickets(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OpenedOrdersTickets (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OpenedOrdersTickets(OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest) → OpenedOrdersTicketsReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::OpenedOrdersTickets(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning only the int32 ticket numbers of the currently live orders — nothing else.
  • Why you need it. A cheap, frequent poll to detect whether the set of open orders changed without transferring full order detail.
  • Sanity check. tickets_size() is the live order count; each value is a positive ticket id.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it as a change detector / lightweight heartbeat:

  • Poll every second to see if any order appeared or disappeared, then call OpenedOrders only when the set changes.
  • Keep a local set of known tickets and diff it against the latest snapshot.
  • Build a minimal "N orders open" indicator with the smallest possible payload.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Returns just the ticket numbers of live orders (lighter than openedOrders).
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsData openedOrdersTickets(const pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest {} (empty message — just pass the default)

Reply message:

OpenedOrdersTicketsReply {
  oneof response {
    OpenedOrdersTicketsData data  = 1;
    Error                   error = 2;
  }
}

MT4Account unwraps the oneof: it returns data on success and throws ApiError otherwise.

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description req const pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest& Empty request message — pass {}.

There is no ctx parameter. The deadline comes from ClientOptions::unaryTimeoutMs (default 30000 ms); transient failures retry automatically.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — OpenedOrdersTicketsData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description tickets tickets() RepeatedField<int32_t> Ticket numbers of all live orders (market + pending). Use tickets_size() / range-for / tickets(i).

Tickets are int32 on MT4. The list covers all live orders — there is no per-type filter here; use OpenedOrders for the type.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Smallest payload. This returns only integers — ideal for a tight polling loop where openedOrders() would be wasteful.
  • Order is not guaranteed stable across calls; compare as a set, not element-by-element, unless you sort first.
  • Empty is normal. A flat account returns tickets_size() == 0.
  • Push alternative. OnOpenedOrdersTickets streams these snapshots so you don't have to poll at all.
  • Reconnection is automatic, like every read method.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsData t = account.openedOrdersTickets(pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest{});
    std::printf("%d open tickets:", t.tickets_size());
    for (int i = 0; i < t.tickets_size(); ++i) std::printf(" %d", t.tickets(i));
    std::puts("");
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) To a std::vector / std::set
docs.text:
#include <set>
std::set<int32_t> openTicketSet(MT4Account& account) {
    auto d = account.openedOrdersTickets(pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest{});
    return std::set<int32_t>(d.tickets().begin(), d.tickets().end());
}

docs.title: 3) Detect changes (change-driven refresh)
docs.text:
#include <set>
bool openOrdersChanged(MT4Account& account, std::set<int32_t>& known) {
    std::set<int32_t> now = openTicketSet(account);
    if (now != known) { known = now; return true; }
    return false;
}

// Usage: pull full detail only when the set actually changes
std::set<int32_t> known;
if (openOrdersChanged(account, known)) {
    pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
    /* rebuild blotter */
}

docs.title: 4) Diff: which tickets opened / closed
docs.text:
#include <set>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

void diffTickets(const std::set<int32_t>& before, const std::set<int32_t>& after) {
    std::vector<int32_t> opened, closed;
    std::set_difference(after.begin(),  after.end(),  before.begin(), before.end(), std::back_inserter(opened));
    std::set_difference(before.begin(), before.end(), after.begin(),  after.end(),  std::back_inserter(closed));
    for (int32_t t : opened) std::printf("＋ opened #%d\n", t);
    for (int32_t t : closed) std::printf("－ closed #%d\n", t);
}

docs.title: 5) Lightweight "is anything open?" guard
docs.text:
bool hasOpenOrders(MT4Account& account) {
    return account.openedOrdersTickets(pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest{}).tickets_size() > 0;
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryGetTickets(MT4Account& account, std::vector<int32_t>& out) {
    try {
        auto d = account.openedOrdersTickets(pb::OpenedOrdersTicketsRequest{});
        out.assign(d.tickets().begin(), d.tickets().end());
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport failed after retries: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Cheap poll, expensive pull on change
docs.text:
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <set>

void watchOrders(MT4Account& account) {
    std::set<int32_t> known;
    for (;;) {
        if (openOrdersChanged(account, known)) {
            std::printf("Order set changed → %zu open\n", known.size());
            // account.openedOrders(...) here for full detail
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
    }
}

docs.title: 📜 Fetching Closed-Order History
docs.text:
Request: closed orders (OrdersHistoryData) from MT4 within a time window — sorted and paginated. Each row is a HistoryOrderInfo (an order plus its close_time / close_price).

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::ordersHistory(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: OrdersHistory (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: OrdersHistory(OrdersHistoryRequest) → OrdersHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::OrdersHistory(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the account's closed orders in a time range, with a chosen sort order and pagination.
  • Why you need it. Trade journals, P/L reports, reconciliation, computing realized profit, feeding your own statistics.
  • Sanity check. total_count() is how many orders match; orders_info_size() is how many came back in this page.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
Use it to read what already closed:

  • Build a statement / trade log for a day, week, month or custom range.
  • Sum realized P/L (profit + swap + commission) over closed trades.
  • Reconcile against your own records by ticket.
  • Page through a long history without pulling it all at once.

⚠️ Filter out non-trades. History can include OO_OP_BALANCE / OO_OP_CREDIT rows (deposits/credits) — skip them for trade statistics.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Returns closed orders within a time window (sorted, paginated).
    // Uses a doubled RPC deadline internally (histories can be large).
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::OrdersHistoryData ordersHistory(const pb::OrdersHistoryRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OrdersHistoryRequest {
  EnumOrderHistorySortType    input_sort_mode = 1;   // sort of the result
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp input_from     = 2;   // window start, broker clock
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp input_to       = 3;   // window end,   broker clock
  optional int32 page_number    = 4;                 // 0-based page index
  optional int32 items_per_page = 5;                 // page size
  string page_token = 6;                             // opaque cursor (alt. to page_number)
  int32  page_size  = 7;                             // page size (with page_token)
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp input_from_utc = 8;   // window start, UTC
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp input_to_utc   = 9;   // window end,   UTC
}

Set either the broker-clock window (input_from / input_to) or the UTC window (input_from_utc / input_to_utc) — not both. Paginate with either page_number + items_per_page or page_token + page_size.

Reply message:

OrdersHistoryReply {
  oneof response {
    OrdersHistoryData data  = 1;
    Error             error = 2;
  }
}

MT4Account unwraps the oneof: it returns data on success and throws ApiError otherwise.

  HISTORY_SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_ASC        = 0;
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_OPEN_TIME_DESC       = 1;
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_ASC       = 2;
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC      = 3;
  HISTORY_SORT_BY_ORDER_TICKET_ID_ASC  = 4;

docs.title: OpenedOrderType (output)
docs.text: Same enum as for live orders (OO_OP_BUY … OO_OP_SELLSTOP, plus OO_OP_BALANCE / OO_OP_CREDIT which appear only in history). See OpenedOrders → Related enums.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Always bound the window. Prefer an explicit input_from(_utc) / input_to(_utc); an unbounded history can be huge.
  • Pick one time base. Use the UTC pair or the broker-clock pair, not both.
  • Pick one paging scheme. page_number + items_per_page, or page_token + page_size. Loop until next_page_token() is empty (or you've read total_count() rows).
  • Skip non-trades. OO_OP_BALANCE / OO_OP_CREDIT are bookkeeping rows — exclude them from win-rate / profit-factor math.
  • Doubled deadline. This method intentionally uses 2 × unaryTimeoutMs.
  • Commission spelling is commision() (one “m”), same as live orders.

docs.title: 1) Basic — last 7 days, newest first
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <google/protobuf/util/time_util.h>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;
using google::protobuf::util::TimeUtil;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    int64_t now  = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
    int64_t from = now - 7 * 24 * 3600;

    pb::OrdersHistoryRequest req;
    req.set_input_sort_mode(pb::HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_DESC);
    *req.mutable_input_from_utc() = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(from);
    *req.mutable_input_to_utc()   = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(now);

    pb::OrdersHistoryData h = account.ordersHistory(req);
    std::printf("Matched %d orders (showing %d)\n", h.total_count(), h.orders_info_size());
    for (const auto& o : h.orders_info())
        std::printf("  #%d %-8s %.2f  P/L %.2f\n",
                    o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str(), o.lots(), o.profit());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Realized P/L over the window (trades only)
docs.text:
double realizedPnL(MT4Account& account, const pb::OrdersHistoryRequest& req) {
    pb::OrdersHistoryData h = account.ordersHistory(req);
    double net = 0;
    for (const auto& o : h.orders_info()) {
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BALANCE || o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_CREDIT)
            continue;                                   // skip non-trades
        net += o.profit() + o.swap() + o.commision();
    }
    return net;
}

docs.title: 3) Page through the whole history
docs.text:
#include <vector>
std::vector<pb::HistoryOrderInfo> allHistory(MT4Account& account, int64_t from, int64_t to) {
    std::vector<pb::HistoryOrderInfo> all;
    pb::OrdersHistoryRequest req;
    req.set_input_sort_mode(pb::HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_ASC);
    *req.mutable_input_from_utc() = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(from);
    *req.mutable_input_to_utc()   = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(to);
    req.set_page_size(200);

    for (;;) {
        pb::OrdersHistoryData h = account.ordersHistory(req);
        for (const auto& o : h.orders_info()) all.push_back(o);
        if (h.next_page_token().empty()) break;
        req.set_page_token(h.next_page_token());         // advance the cursor
    }
    return all;
}

docs.title: 4) Win rate & profit factor
docs.text:
void stats(MT4Account& account, const pb::OrdersHistoryRequest& req) {
    pb::OrdersHistoryData h = account.ordersHistory(req);
    int wins = 0, total = 0;
    double grossWin = 0, grossLoss = 0;
    for (const auto& o : h.orders_info()) {
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BALANCE || o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_CREDIT) continue;
        double net = o.profit() + o.swap() + o.commision();
        ++total;
        if (net >= 0) { ++wins; grossWin += net; } else { grossLoss += -net; }
    }
    std::printf("Trades: %d  Win rate: %.1f%%  Profit factor: %.2f\n",
                total, total ? 100.0 * wins / total : 0.0,
                grossLoss ? grossWin / grossLoss : 0.0);
}

docs.title: 5) Group realized P/L by symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>
std::map<std::string,double> pnlBySymbol(MT4Account& account, const pb::OrdersHistoryRequest& req) {
    std::map<std::string,double> m;
    for (const auto& o : account.ordersHistory(req).orders_info()) {
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BALANCE || o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_CREDIT) continue;
        m[o.symbol()] += o.profit() + o.swap() + o.commision();
    }
    return m;
}

void printClosed(const pb::HistoryOrderInfo& o) {
    std::time_t t = (std::time_t)o.close_time_utc().seconds();
    char buf[20];
    std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", std::gmtime(&t));

bool tryGetHistory(MT4Account& account, const pb::OrdersHistoryRequest& req, pb::OrdersHistoryData& out) {
    try {
        out = account.ordersHistory(req);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {

docs.title: "Today" window in UTC
docs.text:
pb::OrdersHistoryRequest todayReq() {
    std::time_t now = std::time(nullptr);
    std::tm g = *std::gmtime(&now);
    g.tm_hour = g.tm_min = g.tm_sec = 0;
    int64_t midnight = (int64_t)timegm(&g);

    pb::OrdersHistoryRequest req;
    req.set_input_sort_mode(pb::HISTORY_SORT_BY_CLOSE_TIME_ASC);
    *req.mutable_input_from_utc() = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(midnight);
    *req.mutable_input_to_utc()   = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp((int64_t)now);
    return req;
}

docs.title: MT4Account · Orders & History — Overview
docs.text:
Everything about orders — the live ones and the closed ones. On MT4 there are no "positions": openedOrders() returns market and pending orders in a single list, openedOrdersTickets() gives just their ticket numbers, and ordersHistory() pages through closed orders in a time window.

These methods are read-only and all live on mt4_term_api.AccountHelper. Each returns a typed *Data payload.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OpenedOrders — full details of all live orders (market orders and pending orders in one list): ticket, symbol, type, lots, open/SL/TP prices, swap, commission, floating profit, open time, magic number.
  • OpenedOrdersTickets — just the ticket numbers of the live orders (a lightweight poll when you only need to know which orders exist).
  • OrdersHistory — closed orders within a time range, with sort mode and pagination; each row adds close_time / close_price to the order fields.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• OpenedOrders → the blotter: one call, every open and pending order with all its numbers. Tell a market order from a pending one by order_type().
  • OpenedOrdersTickets → the cheap heartbeat: did the set of open tickets change since last poll? Far smaller than pulling full details.
  • OrdersHistory → the statement: what closed, when, and for how much — paginated so a long history doesn't arrive in one giant message.

🆚 MT4 vs MT5: MT5 splits positions (net market exposure) from orders (pending/working). MT4 has only orders. There is no positionsTotal / PositionInfo. A single OpenedOrderInfo list carries both the market trades (OO_OP_BUY / OO_OP_SELL) and the pending ones (OO_OP_BUYLIMIT … OO_OP_SELLSTOP). History may additionally contain OO_OP_BALANCE / OO_OP_CREDIT pseudo-orders (deposits, credits). Tickets are int32, not int64.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Key enum Every live order with full details openedOrders OpenedOrdersData OpenedOrderType (output), EnumOpenedOrderSortType (input) Just the open tickets (lightweight) openedOrdersTickets OpenedOrdersTicketsData — Closed orders in a window (paged) ordersHistory OrdersHistoryData OpenedOrderType (output), EnumOrderHistorySortType (input)

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Market vs pending — both live in openedOrders(). Classify by order_type(): OO_OP_BUY (0) / OO_OP_SELL (1) are market; OO_OP_BUYLIMIT (2) … OO_OP_SELLSTOP (5) are pending. The friendly Order::isPending() / isBuy() encode exactly this.
  • commission is misspelled on the wire — both OpenedOrderInfo and HistoryOrderInfo expose it as commision() (one “m”), matching the generated accessor. The same applies to StatsData.
  • Per-order floating profit — OpenedOrderInfo::profit() is this order's current floating P/L (broker-calculated). Net floating = sum over the list, which is also equity − balance from AccountSummary.
  • History can be large — ordersHistory doubles the RPC deadline internally and supports pagination (page_number / items_per_page, or page_token → next_page_token). Prefer a bounded input_from / input_to window.
  • Time fields come in pairs — every order carries open_time (broker clock) and open_time_utc, plus expiration_time(_utc), and history adds close_time(_utc). The raw layer hands you both; MT4Service picks UTC for you.
  • Balance/Credit rows — history may include OO_OP_BALANCE / OO_OP_CREDIT entries that are not trades; filter them out when computing trade stats.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippet
docs.text:
// All live orders (market + pending)
pb::OpenedOrdersData oo = account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{});
std::printf("%d live orders\n", oo.order_infos_size());
for (const auto& o : oo.order_infos()) {
    bool pending = o.order_type() >= pb::OO_OP_BUYLIMIT &&
                   o.order_type() <= pb::OO_OP_SELLSTOP;
    std::printf("  #%d %-8s %.2f lots  %s  P/L %.2f\n",
                o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str(), o.lots(),
                pending ? "PENDING" : "MARKET", o.profit());
}

docs.title: 📊 Fetching OHLC Bars
docs.text:
Request: OHLC bars (QuoteHistoryBarsData, a list of QuoteHistoryBar) for a symbol and timeframe, from MT4's dedicated QuoteHistory service — paginated, with raw int64 times.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::bars(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.QuoteHistory
  • Proto definition: ShowQuoteHistory / bars RPC (defined in mt4-term-api-quote-history.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.QuoteHistory
  • Method: Bars(QuoteHistoryBarsRequest) → QuoteHistoryBarsReply
  • Low-level client (generated): QuoteHistory::Stub bars method (context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning OHLC bars for a symbol/timeframe over a window, with pagination.
  • Why you need it. Classic candlestick data for charts, indicators and backtests.
  • Sanity check. bars_size() > 0; each bar's time() falls inside your window.

⏱️ Timeframe enum alert. bars uses QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME with minute counts (QHB_PERIOD_H1 = 60), not the index enum that quoteHistory uses. The friendly MT4Service::Timeframe matches this scheme.

⚠️ from_time is required. The MT4 gateway rejects a zero/implicit window (QUOTE_HISTORY_FROM_TIME_REQUIRED) — always set from_time (or from_time_utc). MT4Service::lastBars() computes a safe window for you.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Build candlestick charts and compute indicators (MA, RSI, ATR…).
  • Backtest on OHLC data.
  • Prefer bars over quoteHistory when you want minute-count timeframes, pagination and raw int64 times.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // OHLC bars for a symbol/timeframe (timeframe in minutes; from_time REQUIRED).
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData bars(const pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

QuoteHistoryBarsRequest {
  string symbol = 1;
  QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME timeframe = 2;   // QHB_PERIOD_* (minute counts)
  int64  from_time     = 3;                // window start, broker clock (unix sec) — REQUIRED
  int64  to_time       = 4;                // window end,   broker clock (unix sec)
  int32  page_size     = 5;                // bars per page
  string page_token    = 6;                // cursor for the next page
  int64  from_time_utc = 7;                // window start, UTC (unix sec)
  int64  to_time_utc   = 8;                // window end,   UTC (unix sec)
}

Times here are raw int64 unix seconds, not Timestamp. Use the broker-clock pair or the UTC pair.

Reply message:

QuoteHistoryBarsReply {
  oneof response {
    QuoteHistoryBarsData data  = 1;
    Error                error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — QuoteHistoryBarsData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol symbol() const std::string& Instrument echoed back. timeframe timeframe() QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME The timeframe echoed back. bars bars() RepeatedPtrField<QuoteHistoryBar> The bars. Use bars_size(). next_page_token next_page_token() const std::string& Cursor for the next page (empty = last). server_first_time server_first_time() int64_t Earliest available bar time (broker). server_first_time_utc server_first_time_utc() int64_t Earliest available bar time (UTC).

docs.title: QuoteHistoryBar (one bar)
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description time time() int64_t Bar open time, broker clock (unix sec). time_utc time_utc() int64_t Bar open time, UTC (unix sec). open open() double Open price. high high() double High price. low low() double Low price. close close() double Close price. tick_volume tick_volume() int64_t Tick (quote) volume. real_volume real_volume() int64_t Real (exchange) volume, if any. spread spread() int32_t Spread in points.

Times are int64 unix seconds — no Timestamp conversion needed (pass straight to std::gmtime).

docs.title: 🧱 Related enum — QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME
docs.text:
enum QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME {
  QHB_PERIOD_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  QHB_PERIOD_M1  = 1;    QHB_PERIOD_M5  = 5;    QHB_PERIOD_M15 = 15;
  QHB_PERIOD_M30 = 30;   QHB_PERIOD_H1  = 60;   QHB_PERIOD_H4  = 240;
  QHB_PERIOD_D1  = 1440; QHB_PERIOD_W1  = 10080; QHB_PERIOD_MN1 = 43200;
}

These are minute counts. QHB_PERIOD_H1 = 60, QHB_PERIOD_D1 = 1440. The friendly MT4Service::Timeframe uses the same numeric values.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• from_time (or from_time_utc) is mandatory — omit it and the gateway returns QUOTE_HISTORY_FROM_TIME_REQUIRED.
  • Minute-count timeframe — don't pass a QH_PERIOD_* index here.
  • Paginate with page_size + page_token → next_page_token for long ranges.
  • Raw int64 times — unlike HistoryQuote, no Timestamp.
  • server_first_time tells you how far back the broker's history goes.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic — last week of H1 bars
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    int64_t now  = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest req;
    req.set_symbol("EURUSD");
    req.set_timeframe(pb::QHB_PERIOD_H1);
    req.set_from_time_utc(now - 7 * 24 * 3600);     // REQUIRED
    req.set_to_time_utc(now);
    req.set_page_size(500);

    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData d = account.bars(req);
    std::printf("%d bars\n", d.bars_size());
    for (const auto& b : d.bars())
        std::printf("  O %.5f H %.5f L %.5f C %.5f  vol %lld\n",
                    b.open(), b.high(), b.low(), b.close(), (long long)b.tick_volume());
    return 0;
}

#include <vector>
std::vector<pb::QuoteHistoryBar> allBars(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym,
        pb::QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME tf, int64_t fromUnix, int64_t toUnix) {
    std::vector<pb::QuoteHistoryBar> out;
    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym); req.set_timeframe(tf);
    req.set_from_time_utc(fromUnix); req.set_to_time_utc(toUnix);
    req.set_page_size(1000);
    for (;;) {
        pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData d = account.bars(req);
        for (const auto& b : d.bars()) out.push_back(b);
        if (d.next_page_token().empty()) break;
        req.set_page_token(d.next_page_token());
    }
    return out;
}

    for (const auto& b : d.bars()) {
        std::time_t t = (std::time_t)b.time_utc();   // already unix seconds
        char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", std::gmtime(&t));
        std::printf("[%s] O%.5f H%.5f L%.5f C%.5f\n",

docs.title: 4) ATR (Average True Range)
docs.text:
double atr(const pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData& d, int period) {
    int n = d.bars_size();
    if (n < period + 1) return 0;
    double sum = 0;
    for (int i = n - period; i < n; ++i) {
        const auto& cur = d.bars(i);
        const auto& prv = d.bars(i - 1);
        double tr = std::max({ cur.high() - cur.low(),
                               std::fabs(cur.high() - prv.close()),
                               std::fabs(cur.low()  - prv.close()) });
        sum += tr;
    }
    return sum / period;
}

docs.title: 5) Daily bars for the last 30 days
docs.text:
pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData dailyBars(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    int64_t now = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym);
    req.set_timeframe(pb::QHB_PERIOD_D1);          // 1440
    req.set_from_time_utc(now - 30 * 24 * 3600);
    req.set_to_time_utc(now);
    req.set_page_size(60);
    return account.bars(req);
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling (missing from_time is a common mistake)
docs.text:
bool tryBars(MT4Account& account, const pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest& req, pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData& out) {
    try { out = account.bars(req); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Bars rejected: %s\n", e.what());   // e.g. QUOTE_HISTORY_FROM_TIME_REQUIRED
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Last N bars (mirror of MT4Service::lastBars)
docs.text:
pb::QuoteHistoryBarsData lastBars(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym,
                                  pb::QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME tfMinutes, int count) {
    int64_t now  = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
    int64_t span = (int64_t)tfMinutes * 60 * count;
    int64_t from = now - span * 3 - 7 * 24 * 3600;    // pad for gaps/weekends
    pb::QuoteHistoryBarsRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym); req.set_timeframe(tfMinutes);
    req.set_from_time_utc(from); req.set_to_time_utc(now);
    req.set_page_size(count * 2);
    return account.bars(req);
}

docs.title: 💱 Getting a Live Quote
docs.text:
Request: the latest bid/ask (+ session high/low) for one symbol (QuoteData) from MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::quote(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: Quote (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: Quote(QuoteRequest) → QuoteReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfo::Stub::Quote(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the current bid, ask, session high / low and a timestamp for a single symbol.
  • Why you need it. Price tickers, spread checks, mid-price calc, a pre-trade price read.
  • Sanity check. bid() and ask() are positive and ask() >= bid().

🆚 No last / volume. MT4 quotes carry only bid/ask + session high/low. There is no last-trade price or tick volume on a quote (per-symbol volume lives on SymbolParamsMany).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Show a live price for one instrument.
  • Compute spread (ask − bid) and mid ((ask + bid) / 2).
  • Read a reference price just before sending an order.

Select first. If the symbol is not in Market Watch, the quote can be empty/stale — call symbolSelect(sym, true) once.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Latest quote (bid/ask + session high/low) for one symbol.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::QuoteData quote(const pb::QuoteRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

QuoteRequest {
  string symbol = 1;   // e.g. "EURUSD"
}

Reply message:

QuoteReply {
  oneof response {
    QuoteData data  = 1;
    Error     error = 2;
  }
}

MT4Account returns data on success and throws ApiError otherwise (e.g. unknown symbol).

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — QuoteData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol symbol() const std::string& The symbol echoed back. bid bid() double Current bid price. ask ask() double Current ask price. high high() double Session high. low low() double Session low. date_time date_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Quote time, broker clock. date_time_utc date_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Quote time, UTC.

Spread in points needs the symbol's point() (from SymbolParamsMany): (ask − bid) / point.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select the symbol first for a reliable quote (see SymbolSelect).
  • Unknown symbol throws ApiError; catch it if the symbol name is user-supplied.
  • No last/volume on MT4 quotes — use bars for volume.
  • Streaming alternative: OnSymbolTick pushes ticks so you don't poll.
  • Reconnection is automatic, like every read.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::QuoteRequest req; req.set_symbol("EURUSD");
    pb::QuoteData d = account.quote(req);
    std::printf("%s  bid %.5f  ask %.5f  (hi %.5f / lo %.5f)\n",
                d.symbol().c_str(), d.bid(), d.ask(), d.high(), d.low());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Spread and mid-price
docs.text:
void spreadMid(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double point) {
    pb::QuoteRequest req; req.set_symbol(sym);
    pb::QuoteData d = account.quote(req);
    double spread = (d.ask() - d.bid()) / point;    // in points
    double mid    = (d.ask() + d.bid()) / 2.0;
    std::printf("%s  spread %.1f pts  mid %.5f\n", sym.c_str(), spread, mid);
}

docs.title: 3) Select-then-quote helper
docs.text:
pb::QuoteData quoteSelected(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    pb::SymbolSelectRequest sel; sel.set_symbol(sym); sel.set_select(true);
    account.symbolSelect(sel);                      // ensure it's in Market Watch
    pb::QuoteRequest q; q.set_symbol(sym);
    return account.quote(q);
}

docs.title: 4) Pre-trade price read
docs.text:
bool priceOK(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double maxSpreadPts, double point) {
    pb::QuoteRequest req; req.set_symbol(sym);
    pb::QuoteData d = account.quote(req);
    return (d.ask() - d.bid()) / point <= maxSpreadPts;   // don't trade on a blown-out spread
}

docs.title: 5) Quote time in UTC
docs.text:
#include <ctime>
void quoteTime(const pb::QuoteData& d) {
    std::time_t t = (std::time_t)d.date_time_utc().seconds();
    char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::gmtime(&t));
    std::printf("%s @ %s UTC\n", d.symbol().c_str(), buf);
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling (user-supplied symbol)
docs.text:
bool tryQuote(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, pb::QuoteData& out) {
    try {
        pb::QuoteRequest req; req.set_symbol(sym);
        out = account.quote(req);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Quote failed for %s: %s\n", sym.c_str(), e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Poll a single symbol
docs.text:
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
void tick(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, std::chrono::milliseconds every) {
    for (;;) {
        pb::QuoteRequest req; req.set_symbol(sym);
        pb::QuoteData d = account.quote(req);
        std::printf("\r%s %.5f / %.5f", sym.c_str(), d.bid(), d.ask());
        std::fflush(stdout);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(every);
    }
}

docs.title: 📈 Fetching Historical Quotes
docs.text:
Request: historical quote rows (QuoteHistoryData, a list of HistoryQuote) for a symbol and timeframe over a time window, from MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::quoteHistory(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: QuoteHistory (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: QuoteHistory(QuoteHistoryRequest) → QuoteHistoryReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfo::Stub::QuoteHistory(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning historical quote rows (HistoryQuote: OHLC + spread + volume, with Timestamp times) for a symbol/timeframe in [from, to].
  • Why you need it. Charts, indicators and backtests when you want the MarketInfo series (times already as Timestamp).
  • Sanity check. historical_quotes_size() > 0 and the rows' times fall inside your window.

⏱️ Timeframe enum alert. quoteHistory uses ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME (small indices: QH_PERIOD_H1 = 4), not the minute-count enum that bars uses. See the overview's two-enum table.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Pull an OHLC-style quote series for charting/indicators.
  • Prefer this over bars when you want Timestamp times and the MarketInfo row shape; prefer bars when you want raw int64 times and built-in pagination.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Historical quote rows for a symbol/timeframe over a window.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::QuoteHistoryData quoteHistory(const pb::QuoteHistoryRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

QuoteHistoryRequest {
  string symbol = 1;
  ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME timeframe = 2;   // QH_PERIOD_* (indices 0..8)
  google.protobuf.Timestamp fromTime    = 3;    // window start, broker clock
  google.protobuf.Timestamp toTime      = 4;    // window end,   broker clock
  google.protobuf.Timestamp fromTimeUtc = 5;    // window start, UTC
  google.protobuf.Timestamp toTimeUtc   = 6;    // window end,   UTC
}

Set either the broker-clock pair (fromTime/toTime) or the UTC pair (fromTimeUtc/toTimeUtc).

Reply message:

QuoteHistoryReply {
  oneof response {
    QuoteHistoryData data  = 1;
    Error            error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — QuoteHistoryData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description historical_quotes historical_quotes() RepeatedPtrField<HistoryQuote> The quote rows. Use historical_quotes_size().

docs.title: HistoryQuote (one row)
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol symbol() const std::string& Instrument. index index() int32_t Row index in the series. time time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Row time, broker clock. time_utc time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Row time, UTC. open open() double Open price. high high() double High price. low low() double Low price. close close() double Close price. spread spread() int32_t Spread in points. tick_volume tick_volume() int64_t Tick (quote) volume. real_volume real_volume() int64_t Real (exchange) volume, if any.

Unlike QuoteHistoryBar, HistoryQuote::time() is a Timestamp (not raw int64).

docs.title: 🧱 Related enum — ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME
docs.text:
enum ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME {
  QH_PERIOD_M1  = 0;  QH_PERIOD_M5  = 1;  QH_PERIOD_M15 = 2;  QH_PERIOD_M30 = 3;
  QH_PERIOD_H1  = 4;  QH_PERIOD_H4  = 5;  QH_PERIOD_D1  = 6;  QH_PERIOD_W1  = 7;
  QH_PERIOD_MN1 = 8;
}

These are indices, not minutes. QH_PERIOD_H1 = 4. Do not pass 60 here — that's the bars enum.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Bound the window. Supply fromTime(_utc) / toTime(_utc) so you don't pull more than needed.
  • One time base. Use the UTC pair or the broker-clock pair, not both.
  • Don't confuse the two history methods — see Bars and the overview table.
  • Select the symbol if it isn't already in Market Watch.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic — last 24h of H1 rows
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <google/protobuf/util/time_util.h>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;
using google::protobuf::util::TimeUtil;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    int64_t now  = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
    int64_t from = now - 24 * 3600;

    pb::QuoteHistoryRequest req;
    req.set_symbol("EURUSD");
    req.set_timeframe(pb::QH_PERIOD_H1);
    *req.mutable_fromtimeutc() = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(from);
    *req.mutable_totimeutc()   = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(now);

    pb::QuoteHistoryData h = account.quoteHistory(req);
    std::printf("%d rows\n", h.historical_quotes_size());
    for (const auto& q : h.historical_quotes())
        std::printf("  O %.5f H %.5f L %.5f C %.5f  vol %lld\n",
                    q.open(), q.high(), q.low(), q.close(), (long long)q.tick_volume());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Highest high / lowest low over the window
docs.text:
void rangeHL(const pb::QuoteHistoryData& h) {
    double hi = -1e18, lo = 1e18;
    for (const auto& q : h.historical_quotes()) { hi = std::max(hi, q.high()); lo = std::min(lo, q.low()); }
    std::printf("Range: %.5f .. %.5f\n", lo, hi);
}

docs.title: 3) Simple moving average of closes
docs.text:
double smaClose(const pb::QuoteHistoryData& h, int period) {
    int n = h.historical_quotes_size();
    if (n < period) return 0;
    double sum = 0;
    for (int i = n - period; i < n; ++i) sum += h.historical_quotes(i).close();
    return sum / period;
}

docs.title: 4) Print rows with UTC time
docs.text:
void printRows(const pb::QuoteHistoryData& h) {
    for (const auto& q : h.historical_quotes()) {
        std::time_t t = (std::time_t)q.time_utc().seconds();
        char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", std::gmtime(&t));
        std::printf("[%s] C %.5f\n", buf, q.close());
    }
}

docs.title: 5) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryHistory(MT4Account& account, const pb::QuoteHistoryRequest& req, pb::QuoteHistoryData& out) {
    try { out = account.quoteHistory(req); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Window helper (UTC)
docs.text:
pb::QuoteHistoryRequest hist(const std::string& sym, pb::ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME tf,
                             int64_t fromUnix, int64_t toUnix) {
    pb::QuoteHistoryRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym);
    req.set_timeframe(tf);
    *req.mutable_fromtimeutc() = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(fromUnix);
    *req.mutable_totimeutc()   = TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp(toUnix);
    return req;
}
