docs.title: 💱 Getting Many Quotes at Once
docs.text:
Request: the latest bid/ask (+ session high/low) for several symbols in one round-trip (QuoteManyData) from MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::quoteMany(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: QuoteMany (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: QuoteMany(QuoteManyRequest) → QuoteManyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfo::Stub::QuoteMany(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that returns a list of QuoteData — one per requested symbol.
  • Why you need it. A watchlist / multi-symbol dashboard without N separate quote() calls.
  • Sanity check. quotes_size() matches (or closely tracks) the number of symbols you asked for.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Refresh a whole watchlist in a single round-trip.
  • Snapshot several correlated instruments at (near) the same instant.
  • Cut latency vs looping quote() per symbol.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Latest quotes for several symbols in one call.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::QuoteManyData quoteMany(const pb::QuoteManyRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

QuoteManyRequest {
  repeated string symbols = 1;   // e.g. ["EURUSD", "GBPUSD", "XAUUSD"]
}

Reply message:

QuoteManyReply {
  oneof response {
    QuoteManyData data  = 1;
    Error         error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — QuoteManyData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description quotes quotes() RepeatedPtrField<QuoteData> One quote per symbol. Use quotes_size() / range-for.

Each QuoteData has symbol(), bid(), ask(), high(), low(), date_time(_utc) — see Quote → Output.

Match by symbol(), not by index — don't assume the reply order equals the request order. Build a map<symbol, QuoteData> if you need lookups.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select symbols first. Symbols not in Market Watch may be missing or stale — call symbolSelect for each once.
  • No last/volume — same as single quote.
  • Don't rely on order — key results by symbol().
  • Batch size is your call — a very large list increases payload; chunk if needed.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
    for (const char* s : {"EURUSD", "GBPUSD", "USDJPY"}) req.add_symbols(s);
    pb::QuoteManyData d = account.quoteMany(req);

    for (const auto& q : d.quotes())
        std::printf("%-8s %.5f / %.5f\n", q.symbol().c_str(), q.bid(), q.ask());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Index by symbol for lookups
docs.text:
#include <map>
std::map<std::string, pb::QuoteData> quoteMap(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms) {
    pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
    for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbols(s);
    std::map<std::string, pb::QuoteData> m;
    for (const auto& q : account.quoteMany(req).quotes()) m[q.symbol()] = q;
    return m;
}

docs.title: 3) Refresh a watchlist table
docs.text:
void printWatchlist(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms) {
    pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
    for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbols(s);
    std::printf("%-8s %12s %12s %10s\n", "SYMBOL", "BID", "ASK", "SPREAD");
    for (const auto& q : account.quoteMany(req).quotes())
        std::printf("%-8s %12.5f %12.5f %10.5f\n",
                    q.symbol().c_str(), q.bid(), q.ask(), q.ask() - q.bid());
}

docs.title: 4) Widest spread in the basket
docs.text:
std::string widestSpread(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms) {
    pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
    for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbols(s);
    std::string worst; double maxSpread = -1;
    for (const auto& q : account.quoteMany(req).quotes()) {
        double sp = q.ask() - q.bid();
        if (sp > maxSpread) { maxSpread = sp; worst = q.symbol(); }
    }
    return worst;
}

docs.title: 5) Detect a missing symbol
docs.text:
#include <set>
void reportMissing(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& want) {
    pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
    for (auto& s : want) req.add_symbols(s);
    std::set<std::string> got;
    for (const auto& q : account.quoteMany(req).quotes()) got.insert(q.symbol());
    for (auto& s : want)
        if (!got.count(s)) std::printf("⚠️ no quote for %s (select it?)\n", s.c_str());
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryQuoteMany(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms, pb::QuoteManyData& out) {
    try {
        pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
        for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbols(s);
        out = account.quoteMany(req);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Chunk a large watchlist
docs.text:
#include <vector>
std::map<std::string, pb::QuoteData> quoteChunked(MT4Account& account,
        const std::vector<std::string>& syms, size_t chunk = 50) {
    std::map<std::string, pb::QuoteData> all;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < syms.size(); i += chunk) {
        pb::QuoteManyRequest req;
        for (size_t j = i; j < std::min(i + chunk, syms.size()); ++j) req.add_symbols(syms[j]);
        for (const auto& q : account.quoteMany(req).quotes()) all[q.symbol()] = q;
    }
    return all;
}

Reply message:

docs.text:
Parameter Type Description req const pb::ServerTimezoneRequest& Empty request. Optional — defaults to {}.

There is no ctx parameter. Transient failures retry automatically.

docs.title: ⬆️ Output — ServerTimezoneData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description server server() const std::string& Broker server label. utc_offset_seconds utc_offset_seconds() int32_t (optional) Offset from UTC in seconds (positive = ahead of UTC). source source() SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE How the offset was obtained — see enum. validated_utc validated_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp When the offset was last validated (UTC).

utc_offset_seconds is an optional field — check has_utc_offset_seconds() if you need to distinguish "unset" from 0.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enum — SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE
docs.text:
enum SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE {
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_UNKNOWN        = 0;  // not determined
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LIVE           = 1;  // from a live server check
  SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LAST_VALIDATED = 2;  // from the last validated value
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Two ways to get the offset. This method, or the server_utc_offset_seconds() / utc_server_time_shift_minutes() fields on AccountSummary (which the SDK caches as MT4Account::serverOffsetSeconds()).
  • Positive = ahead of UTC. utc_offset_seconds() = 7200 means broker time = UTC + 2h.
  • DST shifts the offset seasonally for some brokers — re-read if you run across a change.
  • optional field — use has_utc_offset_seconds() to tell "unset" apart from a genuine 0.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::ServerTimezoneData tz = account.serverTimezone();
    std::printf("Server: %s\n", tz.server().c_str());
    std::printf("UTC offset: %+d sec (%.1f h)\n",
                tz.utc_offset_seconds(), tz.utc_offset_seconds() / 3600.0);
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Offset source label
docs.text:
const char* tzSourceToString(pb::SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE s) {
    switch (s) {
        case pb::SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LIVE:           return "LIVE";
        case pb::SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE_LAST_VALIDATED: return "LAST_VALIDATED";
        default:                                        return "UNKNOWN";
    }
}

docs.title: 3) Convert broker time → UTC
docs.text:
int64_t brokerToUtc(MT4Account& account, int64_t brokerUnix) {
    int off = account.serverTimezone().utc_offset_seconds();
    return brokerUnix - off;   // UTC = broker - offset
}

docs.title: 4) Convert UTC → broker time
docs.text:
int64_t utcToBroker(MT4Account& account, int64_t utcUnix) {
    int off = account.serverTimezone().utc_offset_seconds();
    return utcUnix + off;      // broker = UTC + offset
}

docs.title: 5) Cross-check against AccountSummary
docs.text:
void compareOffsets(MT4Account& account) {
    int tz  = account.serverTimezone().utc_offset_seconds();
    int sum = account.accountSummary().server_utc_offset_seconds();
    std::printf("serverTimezone: %+d   accountSummary: %+d   %s\n",
                tz, sum, tz == sum ? "✅ match" : "⚠️ differ");
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryTimezone(MT4Account& account, pb::ServerTimezoneData& out) {
    try { out = account.serverTimezone(); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Cache the offset once
docs.text:
int serverOffsetCached(MT4Account& account) {
    static int off = account.serverTimezone().utc_offset_seconds();  // read once
    return off;
}

  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::serverTimezone() → ServerTimezoneInfo; toUtc() / toServerTime() convert for you.
  • Sugar layer: time helpers use the Service conversions under the hood.

docs.title: 🧾 Getting Full Symbol Parameters
docs.text:
Request: the full specification (~70 fields) of one, several, or all symbols (SymbolParamsManyData — a list of SymbolParamsManyInfo), from MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::symbolParamsMany(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: SymbolParamsMany (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: SymbolParamsMany(SymbolParamsManyRequest) → SymbolParamsManyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::SymbolParamsMany(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning the complete contract spec per symbol: digits, point, tick value/size, contract size, volume limits, margin, currencies, trade mode and more (~70 fields).
  • Why you need it. Format prices correctly, size positions, compute P&L and margin client-side (MT4 has no server calculators), and know a symbol's trading rules.
  • Sanity check. symbol_infos_size() ≥ 1; symbolname() and digits() are set.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Get digits() / point() to format and measure prices in points/pips.
  • Get tradetickvalue() / tradeticksize() / tradecontractsize() for P&L and sizing.
  • Get volumemin() / volumemax() / volumestep() to validate order volume.
  • Get margininitial(), trademode(), currencies — the full trading rulebook.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Full parameters for one symbol (set symbol_name) or ALL symbols (leave it unset).
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::SymbolParamsManyData symbolParamsMany(const pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

SymbolParamsManyRequest {
  optional string symbol_name = 1;   // one symbol; omit to get them ALL
}

Reply message:

SymbolParamsManyReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolParamsManyData data  = 1;
    Error                error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — SymbolParamsManyData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol_infos symbol_infos() RepeatedPtrField<SymbolParamsManyInfo> One entry per symbol. Use symbol_infos_size().

docs.title: SymbolParamsManyInfo — key fields
docs.text:
~70 fields in total. The proto names are CamelCase but the C++ accessors are all-lowercase. The most-used ones:

Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description SymbolName symbolname() const std::string& Symbol name. Digits digits() int32_t Price decimal places. Point point() double Point size (e.g. 0.00001). Bid bid() double Current bid (snapshot). TheLast thelast() double Last price (snapshot). TradeTickValue tradetickvalue() double Value of one tick in account currency. TradeTickSize tradeticksize() double Minimal price change (tick size). TradeContractSize tradecontractsize() double Contract size (e.g. 100000 for FX). VolumeMin volumemin() double Minimum order volume (lots). VolumeMax volumemax() double Maximum order volume (lots). VolumeStep volumestep() double Volume increment (lots). MarginInitial margininitial() double Initial margin per lot (if provided). CurrencyBase currencybase() const std::string& Base currency. CurrencyProfit currencyprofit() const std::string& Profit currency. TradeCalcMode tradecalcmode() SP_ENUM_TRADE_CALC_MODE Margin calc mode (Forex/Futures/CFD). TradeMode trademode() SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE Disabled / LongOnly / ShortOnly / CloseOnly / Full. SpreadFloat spreadfloat() bool true for a floating spread. is_selected is_selected() bool In Market Watch? Time time() int64_t Snapshot time, broker clock (raw int64). TimeUtc timeutc() int64_t Snapshot time, UTC (raw int64).

Other fields (~50 more) cover session stats (SessionOpen/Close/Volume…), swaps (SwapLong/Short, SwapMode), full margin set (MarginMaintenance/Long/Short/Stop…), stops/freeze levels (TradeStopsLevel, TradeFreezeLevel), bid/ask highs & lows, Isin, Path, SymDescription, etc. StartTime / ExpirationTime are Timestamp.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enums (from proto)
docs.text:
enum SP_ENUM_TRADE_CALC_MODE {
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_FOREX   = 0;
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_FUTURES = 1;
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_CFD     = 2;
}

enum SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE {
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_DISABLED  = 0;  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_LONGONLY  = 1;
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_SHORTONLY = 2;  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_CLOSEONLY = 3;
  SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL      = 4;
}

enum SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION {  // TradeExeMode
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_REQUEST  = 0;  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_INSTANT  = 1;
  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_MARKET   = 2;  SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION_EXCHANGE = 3;
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• All-lowercase accessors — the CamelCase proto names (TradeTickValue) become tradetickvalue(). Mind the Time / TimeUtc are int64, while StartTime / ExpirationTime are Timestamp.
  • Client-side P&L / sizing — MT4 has no orderCalcProfit / orderCalcMargin; combine these fields with TickValueWithSize. The MT4Service / MT4Sugar layers already do this.
  • Pip vs point — a pip is 10 points for 3/5-digit symbols; use digits() to decide.
  • One vs all — fetching all symbols is heavier; set symbol_name when you only need one.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic — one symbol's spec
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest req;
    req.set_symbol_name("EURUSD");
    const auto& s = account.symbolParamsMany(req).symbol_infos(0);

    std::printf("%s  digits=%d  point=%.5f  contract=%.0f\n",
                s.symbolname().c_str(), s.digits(), s.point(), s.tradecontractsize());
    std::printf("  volume: min %.2f / max %.2f / step %.2f\n",
                s.volumemin(), s.volumemax(), s.volumestep());
    std::printf("  tick: value %.5f / size %.5f   margin/lot %.2f\n",
                s.tradetickvalue(), s.tradeticksize(), s.margininitial());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Pip size from digits
docs.text:
double pipSize(const pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& s) {
    // 3/5-digit symbols: 1 pip = 10 points
    return (s.digits() == 3 || s.digits() == 5) ? s.point() * 10.0 : s.point();
}

docs.title: 3) Validate / round an order volume
docs.text:
double clampVolume(const pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& s, double lots) {
    if (lots < s.volumemin()) lots = s.volumemin();
    if (lots > s.volumemax()) lots = s.volumemax();
    double step = s.volumestep();
    if (step > 0) lots = std::round(lots / step) * step;
    return lots;
}

docs.title: 4) Estimate P&L for a price move
docs.text:
// profit ≈ (priceMove / tickSize) * tickValue * lots
double estProfit(const pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& s, double priceMove, double lots) {
    if (s.tradeticksize() == 0) return 0;
    return (priceMove / s.tradeticksize()) * s.tradetickvalue() * lots;
}

docs.title: 5) Is the symbol tradable right now?
docs.text:
bool tradable(const pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& s) {
    return s.trademode() == pb::SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL;
}

docs.title: 6) Scan all symbols (unset name)
docs.text:
void listContracts(MT4Account& account) {
    pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest req;            // no symbol_name → all symbols
    pb::SymbolParamsManyData d = account.symbolParamsMany(req);
    std::printf("%d symbols\n", d.symbol_infos_size());
    for (const auto& s : d.symbol_infos())
        std::printf("  %-10s d=%d contract=%.0f base=%s\n",
                    s.symbolname().c_str(), s.digits(),
                    s.tradecontractsize(), s.currencybase().c_str());
}

docs.title: 7) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryParams(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& out) {
    try {
        pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest req; req.set_symbol_name(sym);
        auto d = account.symbolParamsMany(req);
        if (d.symbol_infos_size() == 0) return false;
        out = d.symbol_infos(0);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch   (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Cache specs by symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>
std::map<std::string, pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo> specCache(MT4Account& account) {
    std::map<std::string, pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo> m;
    for (const auto& s : account.symbolParamsMany(pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest{}).symbol_infos())
        m[s.symbolname()] = s;
    return m;   // reuse for formatting / sizing without re-fetching
}

docs.text:
• TickValueWithSize — a lighter call for just tick value / size / contract size
  • Symbols — the list of symbol names
  • Trading · OrderSend — sizing/validation uses these fields
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::symbolParams(symbol) → SymbolInfo (the useful subset); symbolParamsMany(nameFilter) → std::vector<SymbolInfo>.
  • Sugar layer: MT4Sugar::getMaxLotSize() and risk helpers build on these fields.

docs.title: ➕ Selecting a Symbol (Market Watch)
docs.text:
Request: add or remove a symbol from Market Watch (SymbolSelectData with a success flag), on MT4. A symbol must be selected before it reliably quotes or trades.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::symbolSelect(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Proto definition: SymbolSelect (defined in mt4-term-api-market-info.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo
  • Method: SymbolSelect(SymbolSelectRequest) → SymbolSelectReply
  • Low-level client (generated): MarketInfo::Stub::SymbolSelect(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that toggles a symbol in Market Watch — select = true adds it, false removes it.
  • Why you need it. Many quote/stream/trade calls only work for symbols the terminal is actively watching. Select first.
  • Sanity check. success() is true.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Enable a symbol so quote / quoteMany / onSymbolTick / trading work on it.
  • Tidy up Market Watch by removing symbols you no longer need.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Add (select=true) or remove (select=false) a symbol from Market Watch.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::SymbolSelectData symbolSelect(const pb::SymbolSelectRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

SymbolSelectRequest {
  string symbol = 1;
  bool   select = 2;   // true = add to Market Watch, false = remove
}

Reply message:

SymbolSelectReply {
  oneof response {
    SymbolSelectData data  = 1;
    Error            error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — SymbolSelectData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description success success() bool true if the operation succeeded.

A false means the broker declined (e.g. unknown symbol); an outright error throws ApiError.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Select before quoting/trading — this is the most common fix for "empty quote" or a rejected trade on an otherwise valid symbol.
  • Idempotent. Selecting an already-selected symbol just returns success = true.
  • Give it a moment. After selecting a fresh symbol, the first quote may lag a tick while the terminal subscribes.
  • Removing a symbol you have open orders/positions on is generally a bad idea — keep it watched.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic — add to Market Watch
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::SymbolSelectRequest req;
    req.set_symbol("XAUUSD");
    req.set_select(true);
    std::printf("select XAUUSD → %s\n", account.symbolSelect(req).success() ? "ok" : "declined");
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Select helper
docs.text:
bool select(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, bool on = true) {
    pb::SymbolSelectRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym);
    req.set_select(on);
    return account.symbolSelect(req).success();
}

docs.title: 3) Select then quote
docs.text:
pb::QuoteData quoteAfterSelect(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    select(account, sym, true);
    pb::QuoteRequest q; q.set_symbol(sym);
    return account.quote(q);
}

docs.title: 4) Select a whole watchlist
docs.text:
void selectAll(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms) {
    for (auto& s : syms)
        if (!select(account, s, true))
            std::printf("⚠️ could not select %s\n", s.c_str());
}

docs.title: 5) Remove a symbol
docs.text:
bool unwatch(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    return select(account, sym, false);
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool trySelect(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    try {
        return select(account, sym, true);
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Select failed for %s: %s\n", sym.c_str(), e.what());
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Ensure-selected before any price/trade op
docs.text:
bool ensureSelected(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    return select(account, sym, true);   // safe to call every time; idempotent
}

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::SymbolsData s = account.symbols();

    for (int i = 0; i < 10 && i < s.symbolnameinfos_size(); ++i)

                                   s.symbolnameinfos(i).symbol_name().c_str());

docs.title: 2) Does a symbol exist?
docs.text:
#include <set>
bool symbolExists(MT4Account& account, const std::string& name) {
    for (const auto& si : account.symbols().symbolnameinfos())
        if (si.symbol_name() == name) return true;
    return false;
}

docs.title: 3) Collect names into a vector
docs.text:
#include <vector>
std::vector<std::string> allSymbolNames(MT4Account& account) {
    std::vector<std::string> names;
    for (const auto& si : account.symbols().symbolnameinfos())
        names.push_back(si.symbol_name());

docs.title: 4) Filter by substring (e.g. all USD pairs)
docs.text:
std::vector<std::string> withSubstr(MT4Account& account, const std::string& needle) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    for (const auto& si : account.symbols().symbolnameinfos())
        if (si.symbol_name().find(needle) != std::string::npos)

    return out;

    catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;

docs.text:
bool ensureTradable(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    if (!symbolExists(account, sym)) return false;
    pb::SymbolSelectRequest sel; sel.set_symbol(sym); sel.set_select(true);

docs.title: MT4Account · Symbols & Quotes — Overview
docs.text:
Everything about prices and instruments: live quotes (one or many symbols), two kinds of historical series (quotes and OHLC bars), the symbol inventory and Market-Watch management, full symbol parameters (~70 fields), tick value for P&L, and the broker's timezone.

These methods are read-only except symbolSelect (which toggles Market Watch). They span three services: mt4_term_api.MarketInfo (quotes / history / symbols / select), mt4_term_api.AccountHelper (symbol params, tick value), mt4_term_api.QuoteHistory (bars) and mt4_term_api.ServerTimezone (timezone).

docs.title: Live quotes
docs.text:
• Quote — latest bid/ask (+ session high/low) for one symbol.
  • QuoteMany — the same, for several symbols in one call.

docs.title: Historical prices
docs.text:
• QuoteHistory — historical quote rows (HistoryQuote: OHLC + spread + volume, times as Timestamp).
  • Bars — OHLC bars (QuoteHistoryBar: times as raw int64, paginated) from the dedicated QuoteHistory service.

docs.title: Symbol inventory & management
docs.text:
• Symbols — every symbol the broker offers (name + index).
  • SymbolSelect — add/remove a symbol from Market Watch (required before a symbol quotes or trades).
  • SymbolParamsMany — full parameters for one/all symbols (~70 fields: digits, point, contract size, volume limits, margin, currencies, trade mode…).
  • TickValueWithSize — tick value / tick size / contract size for several symbols — the inputs for client-side P&L and position sizing.

docs.title: Server & time
docs.text: • ServerTimezone — the broker server's timezone / UTC offset.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Need the current price? → quote (one) or quoteMany (many).
  • Need a chart / backtest series? → bars (classic OHLC) or quoteHistory (quote rows).
  • What can I trade? → symbols, then symbolParamsMany for the details.
  • Why is my symbol silent? → it is probably not in Market Watch; call symbolSelect(sym, true).
  • How much is a pip worth? → tickValueWithSize (MT4 has no server-side P&L calculator).
  • What time is the broker on? → serverTimezone, or the offset fields on accountSummary.

🆚 MT4 vs MT5: * Quotes carry no last / volume — only bid, ask, session high / low and a timestamp. (The per-symbol volume lives on SymbolParamsMany.) * No server-side P&L / margin calculators (orderCalcProfit / orderCalcMargin don't exist). Combine tickValueWithSize + symbolParamsMany and compute client-side — which is exactly what MT4Service / MT4Sugar do. * Two different timeframe enums (see the warning below).

docs.title: ⏱️ Two history methods, two timeframe enums — don't mix them
docs.text:
Method Service Row type Time fields Timeframe enum Example values quoteHistory MarketInfo HistoryQuote Timestamp ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME QH_PERIOD_M1=0, M5=1, M15=2, M30=3, H1=4, H4=5, D1=6, W1=7, MN1=8 (sequential indices) bars QuoteHistory QuoteHistoryBar raw int64 unix QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME QHB_PERIOD_M1=1, M5=5, M15=15, M30=30, H1=60, H4=240, D1=1440, W1=10080, MN1=43200 (minute counts)

⚠️ These two enums are not interchangeable. bars wants minutes (H1 = 60), quoteHistory wants a small index (H1 = 4). The friendly MT4Service::Timeframe matches the bars scheme (minute values).

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you need… Use Returns Notes Price of one symbol quote QuoteData bid/ask + session high/low Prices of many symbols quoteMany QuoteManyData one round-trip for a watchlist Historical quote rows quoteHistory QuoteHistoryData HistoryQuote rows, Timestamp times OHLC bars bars QuoteHistoryBarsData paginated; from_time required List of all symbols symbols SymbolsData name + index Enable/disable a symbol symbolSelect SymbolSelectData success flag; needed before quote/trade Full symbol parameters symbolParamsMany SymbolParamsManyData ~70 fields per symbol Tick value / size for sizing & P&L tickValueWithSize TickValueWithSizeData several symbols at once Broker timezone / UTC offset serverTimezone ServerTimezoneData offset + source

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Select before you quote. A symbol absent from Market Watch may return a stale/empty quote or be rejected for trading — call symbolSelect(sym, true) first.
  • bars requires a start time. Unlike MT5, the MT4 gateway rejects a zero/implicit window (QUOTE_HISTORY_FROM_TIME_REQUIRED); always set from_time (or from_time_utc). MT4Service::lastBars() derives a safe window for you.
  • Protobuf lowercases the CamelCase params. On SymbolParamsManyInfo the accessors are all-lowercase: SymbolName → symbolname(), TradeTickValue → tradetickvalue(), TheLast → thelast(), Digits → digits(), Point → point(), Bid → bid(). Time / TimeUtc are int64, while StartTime / ExpirationTime are Timestamp.
  • SymbolsData accessor is symbolnameinfos() (lowercased from SymbolNameInfos).
  • Bar times are int64, not Timestamp. QuoteHistoryBar::time() / time_utc() are raw unix seconds; HistoryQuote::time() (from quoteHistory) is a Timestamp.
  • No last/volume on quotes — see the MT4-vs-MT5 note above.

docs.title: 🟢 Minimal snippet
docs.text:
// Make sure the symbol is live, then read its price
pb::SymbolSelectRequest sel; sel.set_symbol("EURUSD"); sel.set_select(true);
account.symbolSelect(sel);

pb::QuoteRequest q; q.set_symbol("EURUSD");
pb::QuoteData d = account.quote(q);
std::printf("EURUSD  bid %.5f  ask %.5f  (spread %.1f pts)\n",
            d.bid(), d.ask(), (d.ask() - d.bid()) / /*point*/ 0.00001);

docs.title: 🧱 Enums used in Symbols & Quotes
docs.text:
Namespace-scope values (not enum class): write pb::QHB_PERIOD_H1, pb::SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_FULL, etc.

  • ENUM_QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME — timeframe for quoteHistory (indices 0…8). See the table above.
  • QUOTE_HISTORY_TIMEFRAME — timeframe for bars (minute counts). See the table above.
  • SP_ENUM_TRADE_CALC_MODE — SYMBOL_TRADE_MARGINE_CALC_MODE_FOREX=0 / FUTURES=1 / CFD=2 (on SymbolParamsManyInfo::tradecalcmode()).
  • SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE — SYMBOL_TRADE_MODE_DISABLED=0 / LONGONLY=1 / SHORTONLY=2 / CLOSEONLY=3 / FULL=4 (trademode()).
  • SP_ENUM_SYMBOL_TRADE_EXECUTION — REQUEST=0 / INSTANT=1 / MARKET=2 / EXCHANGE=3.
  • SERVER_TIMEZONE_SOURCE — UNKNOWN=0 / LIVE=1 / LAST_VALIDATED=2 (serverTimezone).

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Account: AccountSummary — also carries the broker UTC offset.
  • Orders: OpenedOrders — the prices here value the open orders.
  • Trading: OrderSend — sizing uses tickValueWithSize + symbolParamsMany.
  • Streaming: OnSymbolTick — push live ticks instead of polling quote.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::quote() / quoteMany() / symbolList() / symbolParams() / tickValueWithSize() / bars() / lastBars() / serverTimezone().

docs.title: 🪙 Getting Tick Value & Size
docs.text:
Request: tick value, tick size and contract size for several symbols (TickValueWithSizeData), from MT4 — the inputs for client-side P&L and position sizing.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::tickValueWithSize(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Proto definition: TickValueWithSize (defined in mt4-term-api-account-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.AccountHelper
  • Method: TickValueWithSize(TickValueWithSizeRequest) → TickValueWithSizeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): AccountHelper::Stub::TickValueWithSize(context, request, response)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC returning, per symbol, the tick value, tick size and contract size — exactly what you need to turn a price move into money.
  • Why you need it. MT4 has no server-side P&L / margin calculator; you compute P&L and lot sizes yourself from these numbers.
  • Sanity check. infos_size() matches your request; tradetickvalue() > 0.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Convert a price move to account-currency P&L: (move / tickSize) × tickValue × lots.
  • Size a position for a target risk: lots = riskMoney / (stopPoints × tickValue).
  • Do it for a basket of symbols in one call.

For the full spec (digits, point, volume limits, margin, currencies), use SymbolParamsMany. TickValueWithSize is the lighter, focused call.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Tick value / tick size / contract size for several symbols.
    // Throws ApiError / TransportError on failure.
    pb::TickValueWithSizeData tickValueWithSize(const pb::TickValueWithSizeRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

TickValueWithSizeRequest {
  repeated string symbol_names = 1;   // e.g. ["EURUSD", "XAUUSD"]
}

Reply message:

TickValueWithSizeReply {
  oneof response {
    TickValueWithSizeData data  = 1;
    Error                 error = 2;
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — TickValueWithSizeData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description infos infos() RepeatedPtrField<SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo> One entry per symbol. Use infos_size().

docs.title: SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo (one symbol)
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description index index() int32_t Index of the symbol in the request. symbolName symbolname() const std::string& Symbol name. Accessor is lowercase. TradeTickValue tradetickvalue() double Value of one tick, in account currency. TradeTickSize tradeticksize() double Minimal price change (tick size). TradeContractSize tradecontractsize() double Contract size (e.g. 100000 for FX).

Match by symbolname(), not by position, if you need per-symbol lookups.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Lowercase accessors — symbolName → symbolname(), TradeTickValue → tradetickvalue(), etc.
  • This is the P&L building block — combine with a price move and lots (see examples).
  • Batch friendly — ask for several symbols at once.
  • Need more? Use SymbolParamsMany for digits/point/volume/margin.
  • Reconnection is automatic.

docs.title: 1) Basic usage
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::TickValueWithSizeRequest req;
    req.add_symbol_names("EURUSD");
    req.add_symbol_names("XAUUSD");

    for (const auto& i : account.tickValueWithSize(req).infos())
        std::printf("%-8s tickVal %.5f  tickSize %.5f  contract %.0f\n",
                    i.symbolname().c_str(), i.tradetickvalue(),
                    i.tradeticksize(), i.tradecontractsize());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Price move → money
docs.text:
double moveToMoney(const pb::SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo& i, double priceMove, double lots) {
    if (i.tradeticksize() == 0) return 0;
    return (priceMove / i.tradeticksize()) * i.tradetickvalue() * lots;
}
// e.g. a +0.0010 move on 0.50 lots

docs.title: 3) Risk-based position sizing
docs.text:
// lots so that a `stopPoints`-wide stop risks `riskMoney` of account currency
double lotsForRisk(const pb::SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo& i, double riskMoney,
                   double stopPoints, double point) {
    double perLotRisk = (stopPoints * point / i.tradeticksize()) * i.tradetickvalue();
    return perLotRisk > 0 ? riskMoney / perLotRisk : 0.0;
}

docs.title: 4) Index results by symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>
std::map<std::string, pb::SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo> tvMap(MT4Account& account,
        const std::vector<std::string>& syms) {
    pb::TickValueWithSizeRequest req;
    for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbol_names(s);
    std::map<std::string, pb::SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo> m;
    for (const auto& i : account.tickValueWithSize(req).infos()) m[i.symbolname()] = i;
    return m;
}

docs.title: 5) One-symbol convenience
docs.text:
bool tickValue(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double& tickVal, double& tickSize) {
    pb::TickValueWithSizeRequest req; req.add_symbol_names(sym);
    auto d = account.tickValueWithSize(req);
    if (d.infos_size() == 0) return false;
    tickVal  = d.infos(0).tradetickvalue();
    tickSize = d.infos(0).tradeticksize();
    return true;
}

docs.title: 6) Error handling
docs.text:
bool tryTickValues(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms, pb::TickValueWithSizeData& out) {
    try {
        pb::TickValueWithSizeRequest req;
        for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbol_names(s);
        out = account.tickValueWithSize(req);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e)       { std::printf("Server rejected: %s\n", e.what()); }
    catch   (const TransportError& e) { std::printf("Transport error: %s\n", e.what()); }
    return false;
}

docs.title: P&L of an open order from its price move
docs.text:
// Pair with openedOrders(): move = (current - open) for a buy, negated for a sell.
double orderPnL(const pb::SymbolTickValueWithSizeInfo& tv,
                double openPrice, double curPrice, double lots, bool isBuy) {
    double move = isBuy ? (curPrice - openPrice) : (openPrice - curPrice);
    return (move / tv.tradeticksize()) * tv.tradetickvalue() * lots;
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• SymbolParamsMany — the full spec (digits/point/volume/margin/currencies)
  • Quote — the current price to plug into P&L
  • Trading · OrderSend — sizing before you send
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::tickValueWithSize(symbols) → std::vector<TickValueSize>.
  • Sugar layer: MT4Sugar::getMaxLotSize() and risk helpers use these numbers.

docs.title: 🔄 Closing an Order by an Opposite One
docs.text:
Request: close an order against an opposite order on the same symbol (OrderCloseByData), on MT4. Netting two hedged trades this way avoids paying the spread on a separate close.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::orderCloseBy(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderCloseBy (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderCloseBy(OrderCloseByRequest) → OrderCloseByReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelper::Stub::OrderCloseBy(context, request, response)

docs.title: 🛑 No retcode — rejection throws
docs.text: On acceptance you get OrderCloseByData{ close_price, profit, close_time }. On rejection (tickets not opposite, different symbols, one already closed…), the call throws ApiError with the MQL4 code. Wrap it in try/catch (const ApiError&).

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that closes one order using an opposite-direction order on the same symbol as the counter-order.
  • Why you need it. Net a hedge (one BUY + one SELL) in a single operation — often with less cost than two independent closes.
  • Sanity check. A returned OrderCloseByData with a sane close_price() and the realized profit().

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Unwind a hedged pair (a BUY and a SELL on the same symbol) against each other.
  • Realize the netted result in one call instead of closing both legs separately.

Requirements: both tickets must be open market orders on the same symbol and in opposite directions.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Close one order against an opposite order on the same symbol ("close by").
    // Returns OrderCloseByData{close_price, profit, close_time}; THROWS ApiError on rejection.
    pb::OrderCloseByData orderCloseBy(const pb::OrderCloseByRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OrderCloseByRequest {
  int32 ticket_to_close            = 1;   // the order being closed
  int32 opposite_ticket_closing_by = 2;   // the opposite order used to close it
}

Reply message:

OrderCloseByReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCloseByData data  = 1;
    Error            error = 2;   // → thrown as ApiError
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — OrderCloseByData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description close_price close_price() double Price at which the close-by executed. profit profit() double Realized profit of the operation. close_time close_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Close time, broker clock. close_time_utc close_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Close time, UTC.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Opposite + same symbol + market orders — otherwise the broker rejects with an ApiError.
  • Volumes may differ — if the two legs aren't equal, the larger order's remainder stays open (broker-dependent).
  • Not for pendings — close-by applies to live market orders only; delete a pending with OrderCloseDelete.
  • Catch ApiError and read e.mqlErrorCode.

docs.title: 1) Basic close-by
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

bool closeBy(MT4Account& account, int ticket, int oppositeTicket) {
    pb::OrderCloseByRequest req;
    req.set_ticket_to_close(ticket);
    req.set_opposite_ticket_closing_by(oppositeTicket);
    try {
        pb::OrderCloseByData r = account.orderCloseBy(req);
        std::printf("closed-by @ %.5f  profit %.2f\n", r.close_price(), r.profit());
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("close-by failed: %s (%d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
        return false;
    }
}

docs.title: 2) Find a hedge pair and net it
docs.text:
// Close the first BUY against the first SELL on the same symbol.
bool netHedge(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    int buy = 0, sell = 0;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        if (o.symbol() != sym) continue;
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY  && !buy)  buy  = o.ticket();
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_SELL && !sell) sell = o.ticket();
    }
    if (!buy || !sell) { std::puts("no opposite pair"); return false; }

    pb::OrderCloseByRequest req;
    req.set_ticket_to_close(buy);
    req.set_opposite_ticket_closing_by(sell);
    try { account.orderCloseBy(req); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("net failed: %s\n", e.what()); return false; }
}

docs.title: 3) Net all opposite pairs on a symbol
docs.text:
#include <vector>
int netAll(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    std::vector<int> buys, sells;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        if (o.symbol() != sym) continue;
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY)  buys.push_back(o.ticket());
        if (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_SELL) sells.push_back(o.ticket());
    }
    int done = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < buys.size() && i < sells.size(); ++i) {
        pb::OrderCloseByRequest req;
        req.set_ticket_to_close(buys[i]);
        req.set_opposite_ticket_closing_by(sells[i]);
        try { account.orderCloseBy(req); ++done; } catch (const ApiError&) {}
    }
    return done;
}

docs.title: 4) Record the netted profit
docs.text:
double closeByProfit(MT4Account& account, int t, int opp) {
    pb::OrderCloseByRequest req;
    req.set_ticket_to_close(t);
    req.set_opposite_ticket_closing_by(opp);
    try { return account.orderCloseBy(req).profit(); }
    catch (const ApiError&) { return 0.0; }
}

docs.title: 5) Error classification
docs.text:
bool closeBySafe(MT4Account& account, int t, int opp) {
    try {
        account.orderCloseBy({});   // (illustrative) normally fill the request
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("close-by rejected: %s (MQL4 %d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("transport error: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return false;
}

docs.title: Prefer close-by when a hedge exists, else plain close
docs.text:
void unwind(MT4Account& account, const pb::OpenedOrderInfo& o) {
    // look for an opposite order on the same symbol
    for (const auto& x : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        bool opposite = (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY  && x.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_SELL) ||
                        (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_SELL && x.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY);
        if (x.symbol() == o.symbol() && opposite) {
            pb::OrderCloseByRequest req;
            req.set_ticket_to_close(o.ticket());
            req.set_opposite_ticket_closing_by(x.ticket());
            try { account.orderCloseBy(req); return; } catch (const ApiError&) { break; }
        }
    }
    // fall back to a normal close
    pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req; req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket()); req.set_slippage(10);
    try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); } catch (const ApiError&) {}
}

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• OrderCloseDelete — the plain close/delete
  • OpenedOrders — find the opposite ticket
  • OrdersHistory — the netted result lands here
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::orderCloseBy(ticket, oppositeTicket) → CloseByResult{ closePrice, profit, closeTimeUtc }.
  • Sugar layer: hedging strategies call the Service orderCloseBy directly.

docs.title: ❌ Closing a Market Order / Deleting a Pending
docs.text:
Request: close a market order (full or partial) or delete a pending order, by ticket (OrderCloseDeleteData), on MT4. One method covers both; the reply's mode tells you which happened.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::orderCloseDelete(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderCloseDelete (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderCloseDelete(OrderCloseDeleteRequest) → OrderCloseDeleteReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelper::Stub::OrderCloseDelete(context, request, response)

docs.title: 🛑 No retcode — rejection throws
docs.text: On acceptance you get OrderCloseDeleteData{ mode, history_order_comment }. On rejection (e.g. 129 invalid price, 138 requote, 132 market closed), the call throws ApiError with the MQL4 code. Wrap it in try/catch (const ApiError&).

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that either closes a market order (optionally a partial close) or deletes a pending order.
  • Why you need it. Exit a position, cancel a working order, or scale out part of a trade.
  • Sanity check. mode() is OCD_MARKET_ORDER (closed) or OCD_PENDING_ORDER (deleted).

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Close a market order fully, or partially via lots.
  • Delete a pending order that hasn't triggered.
  • Let the server decide which operation applies — you just pass the ticket.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Close a market order (full/partial) OR delete a pending order, by ticket.
    // Returns OrderCloseDeleteData{mode, ...}; THROWS ApiError on rejection.
    pb::OrderCloseDeleteData orderCloseDelete(const pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OrderCloseDeleteRequest {
  int32  order_ticket = 1;
  optional double lots          = 2;   // partial close (market only); omit = full
  optional double closing_price = 3;   // reference close price (market)
  optional int32  slippage      = 4;   // max deviation (points)
}

For a pending order only order_ticket matters; lots / closing_price / slippage apply to market closes.

Reply message:

OrderCloseDeleteReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderCloseDeleteData data  = 1;
    Error                error = 2;   // → thrown as ApiError
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — OrderCloseDeleteData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description mode mode() OrderCloseDeleteMode OCD_MARKET_ORDER = closed, OCD_PENDING_ORDER = deleted. history_order_comment history_order_comment() const std::string& (optional) Broker comment on the resulting history entry.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enum — OrderCloseDeleteMode
docs.text:
enum OrderCloseDeleteMode {
  OCD_MARKET_ORDER  = 0;   // a market order was closed
  OCD_PENDING_ORDER = 1;   // a pending order was deleted
}

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• One call, two behaviors — the server picks close vs delete from the order's type; mode() reports what it did.
  • Partial close — set lots < the order's volume (market orders only). The remainder stays open under the same or a new ticket depending on the broker.
  • Slippage / closing_price help market closes fill in fast markets; a blown price can throw 138 (requote).
  • Deleting a pending needs only the ticket.
  • Catch ApiError and read e.mqlErrorCode.

docs.title: 1) Full close / delete
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

bool closeOrDelete(MT4Account& account, int ticket) {
    pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket);
    try {
        pb::OrderCloseDeleteData r = account.orderCloseDelete(req);
        std::printf("%s #%d\n", r.mode() == pb::OCD_PENDING_ORDER ? "deleted pending" : "closed market", ticket);
        return true;
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("close/delete failed: %s (%d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
        return false;
    }
}

docs.title: 2) Partial close
docs.text:
bool closePartial(MT4Account& account, int ticket, double lots) {
    pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket);
    req.set_lots(lots);                 // close this many lots
    req.set_slippage(10);
    try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("partial close failed: %s\n", e.what()); return false; }
}

docs.title: 3) Close all market orders, delete all pendings
docs.text:
int closeEverything(MT4Account& account) {
    int n = 0;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req;
        req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
        req.set_slippage(10);
        try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); ++n; }
        catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("skip #%d: %s\n", o.ticket(), e.what()); }
    }
    return n;
}

docs.title: 4) Close only losing market orders
docs.text:
void cutLosers(MT4Account& account) {
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        bool market = (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY || o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_SELL);
        if (!market || o.profit() >= 0) continue;
        pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req; req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket()); req.set_slippage(10);
        try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); } catch (const ApiError&) {}
    }
}

docs.title: 5) Delete all pending orders only
docs.text:
int deletePendings(MT4Account& account) {
    int n = 0;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        bool pending = o.order_type() >= pb::OO_OP_BUYLIMIT && o.order_type() <= pb::OO_OP_SELLSTOP;
        if (!pending) continue;
        pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req; req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
        try { if (account.orderCloseDelete(req).mode() == pb::OCD_PENDING_ORDER) ++n; }
        catch (const ApiError&) {}
    }
    return n;
}

docs.title: 6) Close with the current price as reference
docs.text:
bool closeAtMarket(MT4Account& account, const pb::OpenedOrderInfo& o) {
    pb::QuoteRequest q; q.set_symbol(o.symbol());
    pb::QuoteData px = account.quote(q);
    double ref = (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY) ? px.bid() : px.ask();  // close buy@bid, sell@ask

    pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
    req.set_closing_price(ref);
    req.set_slippage(15);
    try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); return true; }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("close failed: %s\n", e.what()); return false; }
}

docs.title: Close all orders on one symbol
docs.text:
int closeBySymbol(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym) {
    int n = 0;
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        if (o.symbol() != sym) continue;
        pb::OrderCloseDeleteRequest req; req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket()); req.set_slippage(10);
        try { account.orderCloseDelete(req); ++n; } catch (const ApiError&) {}
    }
    return n;
}

docs.title: ✏️ Modifying an Order (SL / TP / Price / Expiry)
docs.text:
Request: change an order's stop-loss / take-profit — and, for a pending order, its price / expiration — by ticket (OrderModifyData), on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::orderModify(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderModify (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderModify(OrderModifyRequest) → OrderModifyReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelper::Stub::OrderModify(context, request, response)

docs.title: 🛑 No retcode — rejection throws
docs.text: On acceptance you get OrderModifyData{ order_was_modified }. On rejection (e.g. 130 invalid stops when SL/TP is too close to price), the call throws ApiError with the MQL4 code. Wrap it in try/catch (const ApiError&).

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC to update an existing order's SL/TP (and a pending order's price/expiry).
  • Why you need it. Move a stop to break-even, trail it, retarget a TP, or re-price a pending order.
  • Sanity check. order_was_modified() is true.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Set or move SL / TP on a live market order.
  • Re-price or re-time a pending order before it triggers.
  • Implement break-even and trailing-stop logic.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Modify an order's SL/TP (and price/expiration for a pending order) by ticket.
    // Returns OrderModifyData{order_was_modified}; THROWS ApiError on rejection.
    pb::OrderModifyData orderModify(const pb::OrderModifyRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OrderModifyRequest {
  int32  order_ticket = 1;                     // which order
  optional double new_price       = 2;         // pending orders only
  optional double new_stop_loss   = 3;
  optional double new_take_profit = 4;
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp new_expiration     = 5;   // pending only, broker clock
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp new_expiration_utc = 6;   // pending only, UTC
}

Only the fields you set are changed. (Because they are optional, set the ones you intend to modify.)

Reply message:

OrderModifyReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderModifyData data  = 1;   // { bool order_was_modified }
    Error           error = 2;   // → thrown as ApiError
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — OrderModifyData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description order_was_modified order_was_modified() bool true if the change was applied.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• SL/TP are prices, not distances. Compute them from the symbol's point / digits.
  • Respect the stops level. SL/TP closer than TradeStopsLevel to the market → ApiError 130. See SymbolParamsMany.
  • new_price / new_expiration are for pending orders. Changing the price of a market order is not meaningful.
  • No-op modifies may be rejected — MT4 can return an error if nothing actually changed.
  • Sides matter. For a buy, SL must be below and TP above the market; reversed for a sell.
  • Catch ApiError and read e.mqlErrorCode.

docs.title: 1) Set SL and TP
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

bool setStops(MT4Account& account, int ticket, double sl, double tp) {
    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket);
    req.set_new_stop_loss(sl);
    req.set_new_take_profit(tp);
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("modify failed: %s (%d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode); return false; }
}

docs.title: 2) Move stop to break-even
docs.text:
// pull SL to the entry price once the trade is in profit
bool toBreakEven(MT4Account& account, const pb::OpenedOrderInfo& o) {
    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
    req.set_new_stop_loss(o.open_price());      // SL = entry
    req.set_new_take_profit(o.take_profit());   // keep existing TP
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError&) { return false; }
}

docs.title: 3) Trailing stop by pips
docs.text:
bool trail(MT4Account& account, const pb::OpenedOrderInfo& o,
           double curPrice, double point, int digits, double trailPips) {
    double pip = (digits == 3 || digits == 5) ? point * 10 : point;
    bool buy = (o.order_type() == pb::OO_OP_BUY);
    double newSL = buy ? curPrice - trailPips * pip : curPrice + trailPips * pip;

    // only move the stop in the favorable direction
    if (buy  && !(newSL > o.stop_loss())) return false;
    if (!buy && !(newSL < o.stop_loss() || o.stop_loss() == 0)) return false;

    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
    req.set_new_stop_loss(newSL);
    req.set_new_take_profit(o.take_profit());
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError&) { return false; }
}

docs.title: 4) Re-price a pending order
docs.text:
bool reprice(MT4Account& account, int ticket, double newPrice) {
    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket);
    req.set_new_price(newPrice);                 // pending only
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("reprice failed: %s\n", e.what()); return false; }
}

docs.title: 5) Extend a pending order's expiry
docs.text:
#include <google/protobuf/util/time_util.h>
#include <ctime>
using google::protobuf::util::TimeUtil;

bool extendExpiry(MT4Account& account, int ticket, int extraSeconds) {
    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket);
    *req.mutable_new_expiration_utc() =
        TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp((int64_t)std::time(nullptr) + extraSeconds);
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError&) { return false; }
}

docs.title: 6) Guard against "invalid stops"
docs.text:
bool setStopsSafe(MT4Account& account, const pb::SymbolParamsManyInfo& spec,
                  int ticket, bool buy, double market, double sl, double tp) {
    double minDist = spec.tradestopslevel() * spec.point();   // minimum distance
    if (buy) {
        if (market - sl < minDist) sl = market - minDist;
        if (tp - market < minDist) tp = market + minDist;
    } else {
        if (sl - market < minDist) sl = market + minDist;
        if (market - tp < minDist) tp = market - minDist;
    }
    pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
    req.set_order_ticket(ticket); req.set_new_stop_loss(sl); req.set_new_take_profit(tp);
    try { return account.orderModify(req).order_was_modified(); }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("still rejected: %s\n", e.what()); return false; }
}

docs.title: Modify every open order on a symbol
docs.text:
void setTpAll(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double tp) {
    for (const auto& o : account.openedOrders(pb::OpenedOrdersRequest{}).order_infos()) {
        if (o.symbol() != sym) continue;
        pb::OrderModifyRequest req;
        req.set_order_ticket(o.ticket());
        req.set_new_stop_loss(o.stop_loss());    // keep SL
        req.set_new_take_profit(tp);
        try { account.orderModify(req); } catch (const ApiError&) { /* skip */ }
    }
}

docs.title: 🛒 Placing an Order (Market or Pending)
docs.text:
Request: place a market order (OO_OP_BUY/OO_OP_SELL) or a pending order (*LIMIT/*STOP) and get back the new ticket (OrderSendData), on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::orderSend(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Proto definition: OrderSend (defined in mt4-term-api-trading-helper.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.TradingHelper
  • Method: OrderSend(OrderSendRequest) → OrderSendReply
  • Low-level client (generated): TradingHelper::Stub::OrderSend(context, request, response)

docs.title: 🛑 No retcode — rejection throws
docs.text: There is no success field. If orderSend returns, the order was accepted and OrderSendData holds its ticket. If the broker rejects it, the call throws ApiError with the MQL4 code in mqlErrorCode (e.g. 130 invalid stops, 132 market closed, 134 not enough money). Always wrap this call in try/catch (const ApiError&).

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. One RPC that opens a market order or places a pending order.
  • Why you need it. It's how you enter the market — everything else (modify/close) acts on the ticket it returns.
  • Sanity check. A returned OrderSendData with ticket() != 0 means the order is live.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Open a market BUY/SELL at the current price.
  • Place a pending BUYLIMIT/SELLLIMIT/BUYSTOP/SELLSTOP at a chosen price (optionally with an expiry).
  • Attach SL/TP, a magic number and a comment at entry time.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Place a market or pending order. Returns OrderSendData (ticket/volume/price/open_time)
    // on acceptance; THROWS ApiError (with MQL4 code) on rejection.
    pb::OrderSendData orderSend(const pb::OrderSendRequest& req);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OrderSendRequest {
  string symbol = 1;
  OrderSendOperationType operation_type = 2;   // OC_OP_BUY … OC_OP_SELLSTOP
  double volume = 3;                           // lots
  optional double price       = 4;             // required for pending; for market, the reference price
  optional int32  slippage    = 5;             // max price deviation (points)
  optional double stoploss    = 6;             // SL price (0/unset = none)
  optional double takeprofit  = 7;             // TP price (0/unset = none)
  optional string comment     = 8;
  optional int32  magic_number = 9;            // EA/strategy tag
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp expiration     = 10;  // pending expiry, broker clock
  optional google.protobuf.Timestamp expiration_utc = 11;  // pending expiry, UTC
}

Reply message:

OrderSendReply {
  oneof response {
    OrderSendData data  = 1;
    Error         error = 2;   // → thrown as ApiError (mqlErrorCode set)
  }
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Output — OrderSendData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description ticket ticket() int32_t New order's ticket (your handle). volume volume() double Filled volume (lots). price price() double Fill price (market) / set price (pending). open_time open_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time, broker clock. open_time_utc open_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time, UTC.

There is no status field — the presence of this payload is the success signal.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enum — OrderSendOperationType
docs.text:
enum OrderSendOperationType {
  OC_OP_BUY       = 0;  OC_OP_SELL      = 1;   // market
  OC_OP_BUYLIMIT  = 2;  OC_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;   // pending limit
  OC_OP_BUYSTOP   = 4;  OC_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;   // pending stop
}

⚠️ OC_ prefix for sending. When you read orders the type enum is OpenedOrderType with an OO_ prefix (OO_OP_BUY …). Same values, different enum — don't mix them.

Pending orders need a price. A limit sits better than market (BUYLIMIT below, SELLLIMIT above); a stop sits worse (BUYSTOP above, SELLSTOP below).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Catch ApiError. Inspect e.mqlErrorCode — 130 (stops), 131 (volume), 132 (market closed), 134 (no money), 138 (requote)…
  • Validate before sending. Round volume to VolumeStep and keep SL/TP beyond TradeStopsLevel — see SymbolParamsMany. MT4 has no orderCheck.
  • Select the symbol first (SymbolSelect) so there's a live price.
  • Slippage applies to market orders; widen it in fast markets to avoid 138 requotes.
  • SL/TP are prices, not distances — compute them from the entry and the symbol point.
  • Pending expiry — set expiration_utc (or expiration); omit for good-till-cancelled.

docs.title: 1) Market BUY (with error handling)
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OrderSendRequest req;
    req.set_symbol("EURUSD");
    req.set_operation_type(pb::OC_OP_BUY);
    req.set_volume(0.10);
    req.set_slippage(10);

    try {
        pb::OrderSendData r = account.orderSend(req);
        std::printf("Opened #%d  %.2f lots @ %.5f\n", r.ticket(), r.volume(), r.price());
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        std::printf("Rejected: %s (MQL4 %d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
    }
    return 0;
}

docs.text:
// buy: SL below, TP above, by pip distances
int buyWithPips(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double lots,
                double entry, double point, int digits, double slPips, double tpPips) {
    double pip = (digits == 3 || digits == 5) ? point * 10 : point;
    pb::OrderSendRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym);
    req.set_operation_type(pb::OC_OP_BUY);
    req.set_volume(lots);
    req.set_slippage(10);

}

docs.title: 4) Pending BUYLIMIT with expiry
docs.text:
#include <google/protobuf/util/time_util.h>
#include <ctime>
using google::protobuf::util::TimeUtil;

int buyLimit(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym, double lots, double price) {
    pb::OrderSendRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym);
    req.set_operation_type(pb::OC_OP_BUYLIMIT);
    req.set_volume(lots);
    req.set_price(price);                                   // required for pending
    *req.mutable_expiration_utc() =
        TimeUtil::SecondsToTimestamp((int64_t)std::time(nullptr) + 3600);  // 1h GTC
    try { return account.orderSend(req).ticket(); }

}

docs.title: 5) Reacting to specific MQL4 codes
docs.text:
int sendWithRetry(MT4Account& account, pb::OrderSendRequest req, int maxTries = 3) {
    for (int i = 0; i < maxTries; ++i) {
        try {
            return account.orderSend(req).ticket();
        } catch (const ApiError& e) {
            if (e.mqlErrorCode == 138 /* requote */ || e.mqlErrorCode == 135 /* price changed */) {
                req.set_slippage(req.slippage() + 5);       // widen and retry
                continue;
            }
            std::printf("Giving up: %s (MQL4 %d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
            break;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

docs.text:

    req.set_operation_type(pb::OC_OP_BUY);
    req.set_volume(lots);
    req.set_slippage(10);
    req.set_magic_number(magic);
    req.set_comment("my-strategy");

    catch (const ApiError&) { return 0; }
}

docs.title: 7) Full error classification
docs.text:
int placeSafely(MT4Account& account, const pb::OrderSendRequest& req) {
    try {
        return account.orderSend(req).ticket();
    } catch (const ApiError& e) {
        switch (e.mqlErrorCode) {
            case 130: std::puts("Invalid stops — move SL/TP away from price"); break;
            case 131: std::puts("Invalid volume — round to VolumeStep");       break;
            case 132: std::puts("Market closed");                              break;
            case 134: std::puts("Not enough money");                           break;
            default:  std::printf("Rejected: %s (%d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
        }
    } catch (const TransportError& e) {
        std::printf("Transport error — order may or may not be live: %s\n", e.what());
    }
    return 0;
}

docs.title: Validate volume, then send
docs.text:
int sendValidated(MT4Account& account, const std::string& sym,
                  pb::OrderSendOperationType op, double lots) {
    pb::SymbolParamsManyRequest pr; pr.set_symbol_name(sym);
    const auto& s = account.symbolParamsMany(pr).symbol_infos(0);
    if (lots < s.volumemin()) lots = s.volumemin();
    if (lots > s.volumemax()) lots = s.volumemax();
    if (s.volumestep() > 0) lots = std::round(lots / s.volumestep()) * s.volumestep();

    pb::OrderSendRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym); req.set_operation_type(op); req.set_volume(lots); req.set_slippage(10);
    try { return account.orderSend(req).ticket(); }
    catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("send failed: %s\n", e.what()); return 0; }
}

  • OrderCloseDelete — close the market order / delete the pending
