docs.title: MT4Account · Trading Operations — Overview
docs.text: The four write operations: place an order, modify it, close/delete it, and close one order by an opposite one. All live on mt4_term_api.TradingHelper and all run on the dedicated trade deadline (ClientOptions::tradeTimeoutMs).

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OrderSend — place a market order (OO_OP_BUY / OO_OP_SELL) or a pending order (*LIMIT / *STOP); returns the new ticket, fill volume, price and open_time.
  • OrderModify — change an order's SL / TP, and for a pending order its price / expiration; returns a order_was_modified flag.
  • OrderCloseDelete — close a market order (full or partial) or delete a pending order, by ticket; the reply's mode tells you which it was.
  • OrderCloseBy — close an order against an opposite order on the same symbol; returns close_price and profit.

docs.title: 🛑 The one rule that governs this whole group: no retcode
docs.text:
MT4 trades have no success/return code. If the broker accepts the trade you get a *Data payload back. If it rejects the trade, the call throws metarpc::ApiError whose mqlErrorCode is the MQL4 error. There is no 10009-style status field to inspect — the exception is the result.

try {
    pb::OrderSendData r = account.orderSend(req);   // returned → accepted
    std::printf("Opened #%d @ %.5f\n", r.ticket(), r.price());
} catch (const ApiError& e) {
    std::printf("Rejected: %s (MQL4 %d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
}

docs.title: MQL4 trade error codes (ApiError::mqlErrorCode)
docs.text:
Code Meaning Typical cause / fix 0 no error — 130 invalid stops SL/TP too close to price / wrong side — respect TradeStopsLevel 131 invalid trade volume volume off the VolumeMin/Max/Step grid 132 market closed out of session (e.g. FX on the weekend) — try a 24/7 symbol 133 trade disabled trading off for the symbol/account 134 not enough money insufficient free margin 135 price changed re-read the quote and retry 136 off quotes no price available right now 138 requote price moved; retry with a fresh price / more slippage 146 trade context busy serialize your trade calls

The friendly layers soften this: MT4Service::orderModify() returns bool, and MT4Sugar's send() / close() / modify*() catch ApiError and return 0 / false instead of throwing — so a one-liner never throws on an ordinary rejection.

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Open / place → orderSend.
  • Adjust SL/TP (or a pending's price/expiry) → orderModify.
  • Close a market trade, or cancel a pending → orderCloseDelete.
  • Net two opposite trades against each other → orderCloseBy.

🆚 MT4 vs MT5: orders, not positions. There is no positionsTotal, no server-side orderCheck / orderCalcMargin / orderCalcProfit, and no stop-limit order type. Validate volume and stops yourself (via SymbolParamsMany + TickValueWithSize) before sending.

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you want to… Use Returns Notes Open a market or place a pending order orderSend OrderSendData ticket/volume/price/open_time Change SL / TP (or a pending's price/expiry) orderModify OrderModifyData order_was_modified Close a market order / delete a pending orderCloseDelete OrderCloseDeleteData mode = MARKET vs PENDING Close an order by an opposite one orderCloseBy OrderCloseByData close_price, profit

docs.title: 🧱 Enums used in Trading Operations
docs.text: Namespace-scope values: write pb::OC_OP_BUY, pb::OCD_MARKET_ORDER, etc.

docs.title: OrderSendOperationType — what to place (request of orderSend)
docs.text:
enum OrderSendOperationType {
  OC_OP_BUY       = 0;  OC_OP_SELL      = 1;   // market
  OC_OP_BUYLIMIT  = 2;  OC_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;   // pending limit
  OC_OP_BUYSTOP   = 4;  OC_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;   // pending stop
}

⚠️ Note the OC_ prefix here — distinct from the OO_ prefix of OpenedOrderType used when reading orders (OpenedOrders). Same six market/pending types, different enum.

docs.title: OrderCloseDeleteMode — what happened (reply of orderCloseDelete)
docs.text:
enum OrderCloseDeleteMode {
  OCD_MARKET_ORDER  = 0;   // a market order was closed
  OCD_PENDING_ORDER = 1;   // a pending order was deleted
}

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Catch ApiError around every trade call and read e.mqlErrorCode — that's the only way to learn why a trade failed.
  • Separate deadline. Trades use ClientOptions::tradeTimeoutMs (not unaryTimeoutMs); tune via account.options().
  • Validate first. Round volume to VolumeStep, keep stops beyond TradeStopsLevel, and check free margin — MT4 won't pre-check for you.
  • Pending vs market — one orderCloseDelete handles both; the reply mode disambiguates.
  • Idempotency. A trade call is not safe to blindly retry on a transport timeout — the first attempt may have executed. Re-query OpenedOrders before resending.
  • Market must be open — 132 on the weekend for FX; test on a 24/7 symbol (e.g. BTCUSD).

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Read side: OpenedOrders — the orders you act on here; OrdersHistory — what they became.
  • Sizing inputs: SymbolParamsMany · TickValueWithSize.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::orderSend(OrderRequest) → OrderResult; orderModify(...) → bool; orderClose(...) → void; orderCloseBy(...) → CloseByResult.
  • Sugar layer: buyMarket / sellMarket / buyLimit / … / closeOrder / closeAllOrders / modifyOrderSLTP — one-liners that never throw on an ordinary rejection.

Back to: MT4Account — Master Overview

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Connection State
docs.text:
Subscribe to terminal connection-state changes — connected / alive / api-alive, with the server label and any error — pushed to your callback on a background thread (ConnectStateData), on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::onConnectState(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.Connection
  • Proto definition: OnConnectState (defined in mt4-term-api-connection.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.Connection
  • Method: OnConnectState(OnConnectStateRequest) → stream OnConnectStateReply
  • Low-level client (generated): Connection::Stub::OnConnectState(context, request) (server-streaming)

Unlike the other four streams (on SubscriptionService), this one lives on the Connection service.

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that reports when the terminal's connection state changes.
  • Why you need it. Health monitoring — know the moment the terminal drops or recovers, instead of discovering it when a call fails.
  • Sanity check. Your callback fires with is_connected() reflecting the current state.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Show a live "connected / disconnected" indicator.
  • Pause trading when the terminal is not alive; resume when it recovers.
  • Log connection incidents with the server label and error message.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Subscribe to terminal connection-state changes (connected / disconnected / reconnecting).
    std::unique_ptr<AccountStream> onConnectState(
        const pb::OnConnectStateRequest& req,
        std::function<void(const pb::ConnectStateData&)> callback);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OnConnectStateRequest {
  repeated string terminal_ids = 1;   // terminals to watch (empty = this session's terminal)
}

Streamed payload:

ConnectStateData {
  string id = 1;
  string state = 2;              // textual state
  bool   is_connected = 3;
  bool   is_alive = 4;
  bool   api_is_alive = 5;
  string server = 6;
  uint64 account = 7;
  string error_message = 8;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp timestamp = 9;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Payload — ConnectStateData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description id id() const std::string& Terminal id. state state() const std::string& Textual state label. is_connected is_connected() bool Terminal is connected to the broker. is_alive is_alive() bool Terminal process is alive. api_is_alive api_is_alive() bool The gateway/API link is alive. server server() const std::string& Broker server label. account account() uint64_t Account login. error_message error_message() const std::string& Error text when something is wrong (else empty). timestamp timestamp() google::protobuf::Timestamp When the state was reported.

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• On the Connection service — not SubscriptionService like the other streams.
  • Three liveness flags — is_connected (to the broker), is_alive (terminal), api_is_alive (gateway). All three true = healthy.
  • Background thread + guards — synchronize shared state.
  • Keep the handle alive; inspect lastError() / running().
  • Complements auto-reconnect — unary calls re-attach a dropped terminal automatically; this stream lets you observe the state and gate trading on it.

docs.title: 1) Basic — log state changes
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    auto stream = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [](const pb::ConnectStateData& s) {
        std::printf("[%s] connected=%d alive=%d api=%d  %s\n",
                    s.server().c_str(), s.is_connected(), s.is_alive(),
                    s.api_is_alive(), s.error_message().c_str());
    });

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(30));
    stream->stop();
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Health flag for the trading loop
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<bool> healthy{true};
auto s = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [&](const pb::ConnectStateData& st) {
    healthy = st.is_connected() && st.is_alive() && st.api_is_alive();
});
// elsewhere: if (!healthy) skip sending orders

docs.title: 3) Alert on disconnect
docs.text:
auto s = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [](const pb::ConnectStateData& st) {
    if (!st.is_connected())
        std::printf("⚠️ DISCONNECTED from %s: %s\n", st.server().c_str(), st.error_message().c_str());
});

docs.title: 4) Timestamped incident log
docs.text:
#include <ctime>
auto s = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [](const pb::ConnectStateData& st) {
    std::time_t t = (std::time_t)st.timestamp().seconds();
    char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::gmtime(&t));
    std::printf("[%s UTC] state=%s connected=%d\n", buf, st.state().c_str(), st.is_connected());
});

docs.title: 5) Pause/resume a strategy on state
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<bool> paused{false};
auto s = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [&](const pb::ConnectStateData& st) {
    bool ok = st.is_connected() && st.api_is_alive();
    if (!ok && !paused) { paused = true;  std::puts("⏸ paused (link down)"); }
    if (ok  &&  paused) { paused = false; std::puts("▶ resumed (link up)"); }
});

docs.title: 6) Error / lifetime
docs.text:
auto s = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, cb);
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::minutes(1));
if (!s->running()) std::printf("connect-state stream ended: %s\n", s->lastError().c_str());
s->stop();

docs.title: Gate every trade on live health
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<bool> linkUp{true};
auto guard = account.onConnectState(pb::OnConnectStateRequest{}, [&](const pb::ConnectStateData& st) {
    linkUp = st.is_connected() && st.is_alive() && st.api_is_alive();
});

auto safeBuy = [&](const std::string& sym, double lots) -> int {
    if (!linkUp) { std::puts("link down — not trading"); return 0; }
    pb::OrderSendRequest req;
    req.set_symbol(sym); req.set_operation_type(pb::OC_OP_BUY); req.set_volume(lots); req.set_slippage(10);
    try { return account.orderSend(req).ticket(); } catch (const ApiError&) { return 0; }
};

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• AccountSummary — a one-shot connectivity sanity check
  • OnTrade — order-event stream (on SubscriptionService)
  • Low-level infra: MT4Account::isConnected() / reconnect() — the synchronous connection controls.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::streamConnectState(cb) → ServiceStream, delivering a friendly ConnectState.

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Open-Order Profit
docs.text:
Subscribe to periodic floating-P/L snapshots of all open orders — the server pushes on a timer you choose (OnOpenedOrdersProfitData), delivered on a background thread, on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::onOpenedOrdersProfit(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnOpenedOrdersProfit (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnOpenedOrdersProfit(OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest) → stream OnOpenedOrdersProfitReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionService::Stub::OnOpenedOrdersProfit(context, request) (server-streaming)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes the current floating P/L of every open order every timer_period_milliseconds.
  • Why you need it. A live P/L panel / equity ticker without polling OpenedOrders yourself.
  • Sanity check. Your callback fires on the interval and the list has your open orders.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Drive a real-time P/L dashboard.
  • Watch floating profit cross a threshold (e.g. close-all target or drawdown stop).
  • Get the accompanying account snapshot (equity / margin …) at each tick.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Subscribe to periodic floating-P/L snapshots of the open orders.
    std::unique_ptr<AccountStream> onOpenedOrdersProfit(
        const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest& req,
        std::function<void(const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData&)> callback);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest {
  int32 timer_period_milliseconds = 1;   // how often the server pushes a snapshot
}

Streamed payload:

OnOpenedOrdersProfitData {
  MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE type = 1;
  repeated OnOpenedOrdersProfitOrderInfo opened_orders_with_profit_updated = 2;
  OnEventAccountInfo account_info = 3;
  string terminal_instance_guid_id = 4;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Payload — OnOpenedOrdersProfitData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description type type() MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE Event group. opened_orders_with_profit_updated opened_orders_with_profit_updated() RepeatedPtrField<OnOpenedOrdersProfitOrderInfo> One entry per open order. account_info account_info() OnEventAccountInfo Account snapshot (guard has_account_info()). terminal_instance_guid_id terminal_instance_guid_id() const std::string& Terminal session id.

docs.title: OnOpenedOrdersProfitOrderInfo — key fields
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description ticket ticket() int32_t Order ticket. symbol symbol() const std::string& Instrument. type type() SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE Order type (SUB_OP_*). lots lots() double Volume. open_price open_price() double Entry price. order_profit order_profit() double Current floating profit. swap swap() double Swap. commission commission() double Commission (two m's). stop_loss stop_loss() double SL price. take_profit take_profit() double TP price. magic_number magic_number() int32_t EA/strategy tag. open_time open_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time (open_time_utc too).

(account_info is the same OnEventAccountInfo as on OnTrade: balance/credit/equity/margin/free_margin/profit/margin_level/login.)

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Server-side timer — pushes every timer_period_milliseconds, not on each price change. Don't set it absurdly low.
  • Background thread + guards — synchronize; check has_account_info().
  • Net floating P/L = Σ order_profit() over the list (or read account_info().profit()).
  • Keep the handle alive; watch running() / lastError().

docs.title: 1) Basic — live total P/L once per second
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest req;
    req.set_timer_period_milliseconds(1000);
    auto stream = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
        double total = 0;
        for (const auto& o : d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated()) total += o.order_profit();
        std::printf("\rFloating P/L: %.2f  (%d orders)",
                    total, d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated_size());
        std::fflush(stdout);
    });

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(10));
    stream->stop();
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Close-all profit target
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<bool> hitTarget{false};
pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest req; req.set_timer_period_milliseconds(500);
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [&](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
    double total = 0;
    for (const auto& o : d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated()) total += o.order_profit();
    if (total >= 100.0) hitTarget = true;   // +$100 → signal main thread to close all
});

docs.title: 3) Per-symbol floating P/L
docs.text:
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
std::map<std::string,double> bySymbol; std::mutex m;
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [&](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(m);
    bySymbol.clear();
    for (const auto& o : d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated())
        bySymbol[o.symbol()] += o.order_profit();
});

docs.title: 4) Drawdown guard from the account snapshot
docs.text:
pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest req; req.set_timer_period_milliseconds(1000);
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
    if (d.has_account_info() && d.account_info().margin_level() > 0 &&
        d.account_info().margin_level() < 150)
        std::puts("⚠️ margin level below 150%");
});

docs.title: 5) Worst order right now
docs.text:
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
    const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitOrderInfo* worst = nullptr;
    for (const auto& o : d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated())
        if (!worst || o.order_profit() < worst->order_profit()) worst = &o;
    if (worst) std::printf("worst: #%d %s %.2f\n", worst->ticket(), worst->symbol().c_str(), worst->order_profit());
});

docs.title: 6) Error / lifetime
docs.text:
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, cb);
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(20));
if (!s->running()) std::printf("profit stream ended: %s\n", s->lastError().c_str());
s->stop();

docs.title: Thread-safe snapshot for the UI thread
docs.text:
#include <mutex>
struct PnLSnapshot { double total = 0; int orders = 0; };
PnLSnapshot latest; std::mutex lm;
pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitRequest req; req.set_timer_period_milliseconds(1000);
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersProfit(req, [&](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersProfitData& d) {
    double total = 0;
    for (const auto& o : d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated()) total += o.order_profit();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(lm);
    latest = { total, d.opened_orders_with_profit_updated_size() };
});

docs.title: 📚 See Also
docs.text:
• OnOpenedOrdersTickets — lighter: tickets only, no P/L
  • OpenedOrders — the polling equivalent (full detail)
  • OnTrade — event-driven instead of timer-driven
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::streamOrderProfits(periodMs, cb) → ServiceStream, delivering a friendly OrderProfitEvent.

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Open-Order Tickets
docs.text:
Subscribe to periodic ticket snapshots of the open orders — split into market vs pending — pushed on a timer you choose (OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData), on a background thread, on MT4. The lightweight cousin of OnOpenedOrdersProfit.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::onOpenedOrdersTickets(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnOpenedOrdersTickets (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnOpenedOrdersTickets(OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest) → stream OnOpenedOrdersTicketsReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionService::Stub::OnOpenedOrdersTickets(context, request) (server-streaming)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes just the ticket numbers of open orders every pull_interval_milliseconds — market tickets and pending tickets in separate lists.
  • Why you need it. The cheapest way to detect that the order set changed, pushed instead of polled.
  • Sanity check. Your callback fires on the interval with the two ticket lists.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Detect opens/closes with minimal bandwidth (integers only).
  • Distinguish market exposure from working (pending) orders at a glance.
  • Trigger a full OpenedOrders pull only when the set changes.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Subscribe to periodic ticket snapshots (market + pending) of the open orders.
    std::unique_ptr<AccountStream> onOpenedOrdersTickets(
        const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest& req,
        std::function<void(const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData&)> callback);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest {
  int32 pull_interval_milliseconds = 1;   // how often the server pushes a snapshot
}

Streamed payload:

OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData {
  repeated int32 position_tickets      = 1;   // market-order tickets
  repeated int32 pending_order_tickets = 2;   // pending-order tickets
  google.protobuf.Timestamp server_time     = 3;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp server_time_utc = 6;
  string terminal_instance_guid_id = 5;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Payload — OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description position_tickets position_tickets() RepeatedField<int32_t> Tickets of market orders. pending_order_tickets pending_order_tickets() RepeatedField<int32_t> Tickets of pending orders. server_time server_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Snapshot time, broker clock. server_time_utc server_time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Snapshot time, UTC. terminal_instance_guid_id terminal_instance_guid_id() const std::string& Terminal session id.

Two lists — MT4's "positions" are just its market orders; this stream keeps them separate from pending orders. (It still isn't MT5-style netting.)

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Server-side timer — pushes every pull_interval_milliseconds.
  • Smallest payload — integers only; ideal for a frequent change detector.
  • Compare as sets — ordering is not guaranteed stable across snapshots.
  • Background thread + guards — synchronize shared state.
  • Keep the handle alive; watch running() / lastError().

docs.title: 1) Basic — counts once per second
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest req;
    req.set_pull_interval_milliseconds(1000);
    auto stream = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData& d) {
        std::printf("\rmarket %d  pending %d",
                    d.position_tickets_size(), d.pending_order_tickets_size());
        std::fflush(stdout);
    });

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(10));
    stream->stop();
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Change detection → pull full detail
docs.text:
#include <set>
#include <mutex>
std::set<int32_t> known; std::mutex km;
pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsRequest req; req.set_pull_interval_milliseconds(1000);
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, [&](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData& d) {
    std::set<int32_t> now(d.position_tickets().begin(), d.position_tickets().end());
    now.insert(d.pending_order_tickets().begin(), d.pending_order_tickets().end());
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(km);
    if (now != known) { known = now; std::puts("order set changed — refresh blotter"); }
});

docs.title: 3) Diff opened / closed between snapshots
docs.text:
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
std::set<int32_t> prev;
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, [&](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData& d) {
    std::set<int32_t> now(d.position_tickets().begin(), d.position_tickets().end());
    std::vector<int32_t> opened, closed;
    std::set_difference(now.begin(), now.end(), prev.begin(), prev.end(), std::back_inserter(opened));
    std::set_difference(prev.begin(), prev.end(), now.begin(), now.end(), std::back_inserter(closed));
    for (int32_t t : opened) std::printf("＋ #%d\n", t);
    for (int32_t t : closed) std::printf("－ #%d\n", t);
    prev = now;
});

docs.title: 4) Pending-only watch
docs.text:
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData& d) {
    if (d.pending_order_tickets_size() == 0) return;
    std::printf("%d pending orders waiting\n", d.pending_order_tickets_size());
});

docs.title: 5) Snapshot time
docs.text:
#include <ctime>
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, [](const pb::OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData& d) {
    std::time_t t = (std::time_t)d.server_time_utc().seconds();
    char buf[20]; std::strftime(buf, sizeof buf, "%H:%M:%S", std::gmtime(&t));
    std::printf("[%s] m=%d p=%d\n", buf, d.position_tickets_size(), d.pending_order_tickets_size());
});

docs.title: 6) Error / lifetime
docs.text:
auto s = account.onOpenedOrdersTickets(req, cb);
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(15));
if (!s->running()) std::printf("tickets stream ended: %s\n", s->lastError().c_str());
s->stop();

#include <atomic>

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Live Ticks
docs.text:
Subscribe to real-time ticks for one or more symbols. Each payload (OnSymbolTickData) carries bid/ask plus last and volume — delivered to your callback on a background thread, on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::onSymbolTick(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnSymbolTick (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnSymbolTick(OnSymbolTickRequest) → stream OnSymbolTickReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionService::Stub::OnSymbolTick(context, request) (server-streaming)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that pushes a tick whenever a subscribed symbol's price updates.
  • Why you need it. Live tickers, spread monitors, tick-driven strategies — without polling quote.
  • Sanity check. Your callback fires and d.has_symbol_tick() is true.

🆚 vs quote: the stream's OnSymbolMqlTickInfo includes last() and volume() and millisecond times — the unary Quote does not.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Drive a live price display or spread guard.
  • Trigger logic on every tick (scalping, trailing).
  • Replace a tight quote polling loop with push delivery.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Subscribe to live ticks for the given symbols. Returns a stream handle;
    // keep it alive to keep receiving, stop() / destroy to cancel.
    std::unique_ptr<AccountStream> onSymbolTick(
        const pb::OnSymbolTickRequest& req,
        std::function<void(const pb::OnSymbolTickData&)> callback);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OnSymbolTickRequest {
  repeated string symbol_names = 1;   // symbols to subscribe to
}

Streamed payload:

OnSymbolTickData {
  OnSymbolMqlTickInfo symbol_tick = 1;
  string terminal_instance_guid_id = 2;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
⬆️ Payload — OnSymbolTickData → OnSymbolMqlTickInfo
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol_tick symbol_tick() OnSymbolMqlTickInfo The tick (guard with has_symbol_tick()). terminal_instance_guid_id terminal_instance_guid_id() const std::string& Terminal session id.

docs.title: OnSymbolMqlTickInfo
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description symbol symbol() const std::string& Symbol. bid bid() double Bid price. ask ask() double Ask price. last last() double Last trade price. volume volume() uint64_t Tick volume. time time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Tick time, broker clock. time_utc time_utc() google::protobuf::Timestamp Tick time, UTC. time_msc time_msc() int64_t Tick time, broker (milliseconds). time_msc_utc time_msc_utc() int64_t Tick time, UTC (milliseconds).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Background thread — synchronize any shared state; keep the callback fast.
  • Keep the handle alive — store the unique_ptr; losing it cancels the stream.
  • Guard sub-fields — check has_symbol_tick() before reading.
  • Several symbols, one stream — add them all to symbol_names.
  • lastError() tells you why a stream ended unexpectedly.

docs.title: 1) Basic — print ticks for 5 seconds
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    pb::OnSymbolTickRequest req;
    req.add_symbol_names("EURUSD");
    auto stream = account.onSymbolTick(req, [](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
        if (!d.has_symbol_tick()) return;
        const auto& t = d.symbol_tick();
        std::printf("%s  %.5f / %.5f  last %.5f  vol %llu\n",
                    t.symbol().c_str(), t.bid(), t.ask(), t.last(),
                    (unsigned long long)t.volume());
    });

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
    stream->stop();
    std::printf("received %llu ticks\n", (unsigned long long)stream->count());
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Thread-safe latest-price cache
docs.text:
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
struct PriceCache {
    std::mutex m;
    std::map<std::string, std::pair<double,double>> bidAsk;   // symbol → {bid, ask}
    void update(const pb::OnSymbolMqlTickInfo& t) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(m);
        bidAsk[t.symbol()] = { t.bid(), t.ask() };
    }
};

PriceCache cache;
pb::OnSymbolTickRequest req; req.add_symbol_names("EURUSD");
auto s = account.onSymbolTick(req, [&](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
    if (d.has_symbol_tick()) cache.update(d.symbol_tick());
});

docs.title: 3) Spread-blowout alert
docs.text:
auto s = account.onSymbolTick(req, [point](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
    if (!d.has_symbol_tick()) return;
    const auto& t = d.symbol_tick();
    double spreadPts = (t.ask() - t.bid()) / point;
    if (spreadPts > 30) std::printf("⚠️ %s spread %.0f pts\n", t.symbol().c_str(), spreadPts);
});

docs.title: 4) Count ticks per symbol
docs.text:
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
std::map<std::string,int> counts; std::mutex cm;
auto s = account.onSymbolTick(req, [&](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
    if (!d.has_symbol_tick()) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(cm);
    counts[d.symbol_tick().symbol()]++;
});

docs.title: 5) Stop on a condition (first tick above a level)
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<bool> hit{false};
AccountStream* raw = nullptr;
auto s = account.onSymbolTick(req, [&](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
    if (d.has_symbol_tick() && d.symbol_tick().bid() >= 1.10000) hit = true;
});
raw = s.get();
while (!hit) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
s->stop();

docs.title: 6) Watch for stream errors
docs.text:
auto s = account.onSymbolTick(req, cb);
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(10));
if (!s->running())
    std::printf("stream ended: %s\n", s->lastError().c_str());

docs.title: Subscribe → work → cancel
docs.text:
void withTicks(MT4Account& account, const std::vector<std::string>& syms,
               std::function<void(const pb::OnSymbolMqlTickInfo&)> onTick,
               std::chrono::seconds dur) {
    pb::OnSymbolTickRequest req;
    for (auto& s : syms) req.add_symbol_names(s);
    auto stream = account.onSymbolTick(req, [&](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
        if (d.has_symbol_tick()) onTick(d.symbol_tick());
    });
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(dur);
    stream->stop();
}

docs.text:
• Quote — the unary price (no last/volume)
  • SymbolSelect — select symbols before subscribing
  • OnTrade — order-event stream
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::subscribeTicks(symbols, cb) → ServiceStream, delivering Tick{symbol, bid, ask, last, volume, timeUtc}.

docs.title: 📡 Streaming Trade Events
docs.text:
Subscribe to trade events — orders opening, changing, closing, or landing in history — each payload (OnTradeData) carrying the changed orders plus a fresh account snapshot, delivered on a background thread, on MT4.

API Information:

  • Low-level API: MT4Account::onTrade(...) (from #include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>, namespace metarpc)
  • gRPC service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Proto definition: OnTrade (defined in mt4-term-api-subscriptions.proto)

docs.title: RPC
docs.text:
• Service: mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService
  • Method: OnTrade(OnTradeRequest) → stream OnTradeReply
  • Low-level client (generated): SubscriptionService::Stub::OnTrade(context, request) (server-streaming)

docs.title: 💬 Just the essentials
docs.text:
• What it is. A server stream that fires whenever the order set changes — new orders, updates, removals, and new history entries.
  • Why you need it. React immediately to fills, closes and modifications; keep a local order book in sync without polling.
  • Sanity check. Your callback fires with d.has_event_data() true on a change.

docs.title: 🎯 Purpose
docs.text:
• Keep a live view of orders in sync (new / updated / removed / new-history).
  • Trigger logic on a fill or a close.
  • Capture the account snapshot (balance / equity / margin / profit) that accompanies each event.

docs.title: 🧱 Signature
docs.text:
namespace metarpc {

class MT4Account {
    // ...
public:
    // Subscribe to trade/order events. Returns a stream handle; keep it alive.
    std::unique_ptr<AccountStream> onTrade(
        const pb::OnTradeRequest& req,
        std::function<void(const pb::OnTradeData&)> callback);
};

} // namespace metarpc

namespace pb = mt4_term_api; — the generated protobuf namespace.

Request message:

OnTradeRequest {} (empty — subscribe to all trade events for the account)

Streamed payload:

OnTradeData {
  MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE type = 1;   // OrderProfit / OrderUpdate
  OnTadeEventData   event_data   = 2;        // the changed orders (note the proto typo "OnTade")
  OnEventAccountInfo account_info = 3;        // account snapshot at the event
  string terminal_instance_guid_id = 4;
}

docs.title: 🔽 Input
docs.text:
Parameter Type Description req const pb::OnTradeRequest& Empty request — pass {}. callback std::function<void(const pb::OnTradeData&)> Invoked per event, on a background thread. 
auto stream = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [](const pb::OnTradeData& d) { /* ... */ });

docs.title: ⬆️ Payload — OnTradeData
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description type type() MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE OrderProfit (0) / OrderUpdate (1). event_data event_data() OnTadeEventData (sic) The changed orders (guard has_event_data()). account_info account_info() OnEventAccountInfo Account snapshot (guard has_account_info()). terminal_instance_guid_id terminal_instance_guid_id() const std::string& Terminal session id.

docs.title: event_data — OnTadeEventData (proto typo: one “d”)
docs.text: Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description new_orders new_orders() RepeatedPtrField<OnTradeOrderInfo> Orders that just appeared. updated_orders updated_orders() RepeatedPtrField<OnTradeUpdatedOrderInfo> Orders that changed (prev/current). removed_orders removed_orders() RepeatedPtrField<OnTradeOrderInfo> Orders that were removed/closed. new_history_orders new_history_orders() RepeatedPtrField<OnTradeOrderInfo> Orders that landed in history.

docs.title: OnTradeOrderInfo — key fields
docs.text:
Field (proto) C++ accessor C++ type Description ticket ticket() int32_t Order ticket. symbol symbol() const std::string& Instrument. type type() SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE SUB_OP_BUY … SUB_OP_SELLSTOP. lots lots() double Volume. open_price open_price() double Entry price. close_price close_price() double Exit price (for history/closed). order_profit order_profit() double Order profit. stop_loss stop_loss() double SL price. take_profit take_profit() double TP price. swap swap() double Swap. commission commission() double Commission. Correct spelling (two m's) — unlike the read-side commision(). magic_number magic_number() int32_t EA/strategy tag. is_history is_history() bool true for a history entry. open_time open_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Open time (open_time_utc also). close_time close_time() google::protobuf::Timestamp Close time (close_time_utc also).

OnTradeUpdatedOrderInfo has previous() and current(), both OnTradeOrderInfo.

docs.title: account_info — OnEventAccountInfo
docs.text: Accessor Type Description balance() double Account balance. credit() double Credit. equity() double Equity. margin() double Used margin. free_margin() double Free margin. profit() double Floating profit. margin_level() double Margin level (%). login() int64_t Account login.

docs.title: 🧱 Related enums
docs.text:
enum MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE { OrderProfit = 0; OrderUpdate = 1; }

enum SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE {
  SUB_OP_BUY = 0; SUB_OP_SELL = 1;
  SUB_OP_BUYLIMIT = 2; SUB_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;
  SUB_OP_BUYSTOP = 4; SUB_OP_SELLSTOP = 5;
}

SUB_OP_* is the streaming order-type enum — distinct from OO_OP_* (reading) and OC_OP_* (sending).

docs.title: 🧩 Notes & Tips
docs.text:
• Background thread + guards — synchronize shared state; check has_event_data() / has_account_info().
  • Four buckets — new / updated / removed / new-history; each is a repeated list (may be empty).
  • Correct commission spelling here (commission()), opposite of the unary OpenedOrderInfo::commision().
  • Keep the handle alive; inspect lastError() / running().
  • No request filter — you receive all account trade events; filter in your callback (by symbol / magic).

docs.title: 1) Basic — log order events
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_account.hpp>
#include <thread>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace metarpc;
namespace pb = mt4_term_api;

int main() {
    MT4Account account("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
    account.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

    auto stream = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
        if (!d.has_event_data()) return;
        const auto& e = d.event_data();
        for (const auto& o : e.new_orders())
            std::printf("＋ NEW #%d %s %.2f @ %.5f\n", o.ticket(), o.symbol().c_str(), o.lots(), o.open_price());
        for (const auto& o : e.removed_orders())
            std::printf("－ CLOSED #%d profit %.2f\n", o.ticket(), o.order_profit());
    });

    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(30));
    stream->stop();
    return 0;
}

docs.title: 2) Track modifications (previous → current)
docs.text:
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
    if (!d.has_event_data()) return;
    for (const auto& u : d.event_data().updated_orders()) {
        const auto& p = u.previous();
        const auto& c = u.current();
        if (p.stop_loss() != c.stop_loss())
            std::printf("#%d SL %.5f → %.5f\n", c.ticket(), p.stop_loss(), c.stop_loss());
    }
});

docs.title: 3) React to a fill on a specific magic number
docs.text:
int myMagic = 777;
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [myMagic](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
    if (!d.has_event_data()) return;
    for (const auto& o : d.event_data().new_orders())
        if (o.magic_number() == myMagic)
            std::printf("my order filled: #%d\n", o.ticket());
});

docs.title: 4) Live equity from the event snapshot
docs.text:
#include <atomic>
std::atomic<double> equity{0};
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [&](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
    if (d.has_account_info()) equity = d.account_info().equity();
});

docs.title: 5) Collect closed-order P/L
docs.text:
#include <mutex>
double realized = 0; std::mutex rm;
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [&](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
    if (!d.has_event_data()) return;
    for (const auto& o : d.event_data().new_history_orders()) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(rm);
        realized += o.order_profit() + o.swap() + o.commission();
    }
});

docs.title: 6) Error / lifetime handling
docs.text:
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, cb);
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::minutes(1));
if (!s->running()) std::printf("trade stream ended: %s\n", s->lastError().c_str());
s->stop();

docs.title: Keep a local order book in sync
docs.text:
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
std::map<int, pb::OnTradeOrderInfo> book; std::mutex bm;
auto s = account.onTrade(pb::OnTradeRequest{}, [&](const pb::OnTradeData& d) {
    if (!d.has_event_data()) return;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(bm);
    for (const auto& o : d.event_data().new_orders())     book[o.ticket()] = o;
    for (const auto& u : d.event_data().updated_orders()) book[u.current().ticket()] = u.current();
    for (const auto& o : d.event_data().removed_orders()) book.erase(o.ticket());
});

docs.text:
• OpenedOrders — the polling equivalent
  • OnOpenedOrdersProfit — periodic P/L snapshots
  • OrdersHistory — where new_history_orders end up
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::streamTradeUpdates(cb) → ServiceStream, delivering a friendly TradeEvent.

docs.title: MT4Account · Streaming Methods — Overview
docs.text:
Real-time server streams: live ticks, trade events, periodic floating-P/L snapshots, periodic ticket snapshots, and terminal connection-state changes. Each onX() opens a gRPC server stream and pumps raw protobuf payloads to your callback on a dedicated background thread.

Four streams live on mt4_term_api.SubscriptionService; onConnectState lives on mt4_term_api.Connection.

docs.title: 📁 What lives here
docs.text:
• OnSymbolTick — live ticks for one or more symbols (bid/ask plus last and volume — unlike the unary quote).
  • OnTrade — trade events: orders opening, changing, closing, or landing in history, each with an account snapshot.
  • OnOpenedOrdersProfit — periodic floating-P/L snapshots of the open orders (you set the timer).
  • OnOpenedOrdersTickets — periodic ticket snapshots, split into market vs pending (lightweight).
  • OnConnectState — terminal connection-state changes (connected / alive / api-alive).

docs.title: 🔌 How streaming works — the AccountStream handle
docs.text:
Every onX() returns a std::unique_ptr<AccountStream>. The SDK reads the stream on a background thread and calls your callback for each message.

class AccountStream {
public:
    void stop();                    // cancel the stream and join the reader thread (idempotent)
    bool running() const;           // false once the stream ended or was cancelled
    uint64_t count() const;         // payloads delivered to the callback so far
    std::string lastError() const;  // the error that ended the stream, or "" if clean
};
  • Keep the handle alive to keep receiving — destroying it (or calling stop()) cancels the subscription.
  • The callback runs on another thread — guard shared state (mutex / atomics); don't block it for long.
  • lastError() is "" on a clean end, otherwise the reason the stream stopped.
pb::OnSymbolTickRequest req;
req.add_symbol_names("EURUSD");
auto stream = account.onSymbolTick(req, [](const pb::OnSymbolTickData& d) {
    if (d.has_symbol_tick())
        std::printf("%s %.5f/%.5f\n", d.symbol_tick().symbol().c_str(),
                    d.symbol_tick().bid(), d.symbol_tick().ask());
});
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
stream->stop();   // (also happens automatically when `stream` is destroyed)

docs.title: 🧭 Plain English
docs.text:
• Live prices → onSymbolTick.
  • "Tell me when an order changes" → onTrade.
  • "Update my floating P/L every N ms" → onOpenedOrdersProfit.
  • "Tell me which tickets exist, cheaply" → onOpenedOrdersTickets.
  • "Is the terminal still connected?" → onConnectState.

🆚 MT4 vs MT5: the tick stream (OnSymbolMqlTickInfo) does carry last and volume (the unary quote does not). Trade/profit events talk orders, not positions, and the streamed order type uses the SUB_OP_* enum. Note OnTradeOrderInfo::commission() is spelled correctly here (two m's) — unlike the read-side OpenedOrderInfo::commision().

docs.title: Quick choose
docs.text: If you want… Use Request knob Payload Live ticks (bid/ask/last/volume) onSymbolTick symbol_names OnSymbolTickData Order lifecycle events onTrade — (empty request) OnTradeData Floating-P/L on a timer onOpenedOrdersProfit timer_period_milliseconds OnOpenedOrdersProfitData Ticket snapshots on a timer onOpenedOrdersTickets pull_interval_milliseconds OnOpenedOrdersTicketsData Connection-state changes onConnectState terminal_ids ConnectStateData

docs.title: 🧱 Enums used in Streaming
docs.text: Namespace-scope values: pb::SUB_OP_BUY, pb::OrderUpdate, etc.

docs.title: SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE — streamed order type
docs.text:
enum SUB_ORDER_OPERATION_TYPE {
  SUB_OP_BUY      = 0;  SUB_OP_SELL      = 1;   // market
  SUB_OP_BUYLIMIT = 2;  SUB_OP_SELLLIMIT = 3;   // pending limit
  SUB_OP_BUYSTOP  = 4;  SUB_OP_SELLSTOP  = 5;   // pending stop
}

A third order-type enum: SUB_OP_* on streams, vs OO_OP_* when reading (OpenedOrders) and OC_OP_* when sending (OrderSend). Same six values, three prefixes.

docs.title: MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE — event group (on OnTradeData / OnOpenedOrdersProfitData)
docs.text:
enum MT4_SUB_ENUM_EVENT_GROUP_TYPE {
  OrderProfit = 0;   // a profit-update group
  OrderUpdate = 1;   // an order-change group
}

docs.title: ❌ Cross-refs & gotchas
docs.text:
• Thread safety. Callbacks fire on a background thread — never touch UI/shared state without synchronization, and keep the callback short.
  • Lifetime. The subscription lives as long as the AccountStream handle; store it, don't let it go out of scope.
  • has_* guards. Payloads use message sub-fields (has_symbol_tick(), has_event_data(), has_account_info()) — check before reading.
  • Timers are server-side. onOpenedOrdersProfit / onOpenedOrdersTickets push on the interval you request, not on every change.
  • Reconnect. A dropped terminal is re-attached for unary calls automatically; for streams, watch running() / lastError() and re-subscribe if needed.

docs.title: See also
docs.text:
• Poll instead of push: Quote · OpenedOrders · OpenedOrdersTickets.
  • Friendly layer: MT4Service::subscribeTicks() / streamTradeUpdates() / streamOrderProfits() / streamOpenedTickets() / streamConnectState() return a ServiceStream and deliver friendly structs (Tick, TradeEvent, OrderProfitEvent, TicketsSnapshot, ConnectState).

Back to: MT4Account — Master Overview

docs.title: MT4Service — 1. Account Information
docs.text:
Account snapshot and performance statistics as friendly structs — no protobuf, times in UTC.

Each method delegates to the matching MT4Account call and converts the reply. For the full per-field proto detail, follow the links to the MT4Account pages.

#include <metarpc/mt4_service.hpp>
using namespace metarpc;

MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

docs.title: accountSummary()
docs.text:
AccountInfo accountSummary();
AccountInfo getAccountInfo();   // legacy alias

Full account snapshot in one call. (Low-level: AccountSummary.)

Returns — AccountInfo:

Field Type Description login int64_t Account login currency std::string Deposit currency balance double Balance (no floating P/L) equity double Balance + floating P/L credit double Credit margin / marginFree / marginLevel double Used / free margin, level (%) leverage int64_t e.g. 100 = 1:100 name / company std::string Holder / broker name tradeMode TradeMode Demo / Contest / Real investor bool Read-only (investor) login tradeAllowed / tradeExpert bool Manual / EA trading permitted serverTime / serverTimeUtc int64_t Broker / UTC time (unix sec) utcShiftMinutes int64_t Broker clock minus UTC (minutes) server std::string Broker server name 
AccountInfo a = svc.accountSummary();
std::printf("%lld  bal %.2f  eq %.2f  free %.2f %s\n",
            (long long)a.login, a.balance, a.equity, a.marginFree, a.currency.c_str());
double floating = a.equity - a.balance;   // MT4 has no dedicated profit field

docs.title: equityHistory()
docs.text:
std::vector<EquityPoint> equityHistory();

The balance/equity curve points. (Low-level: EquityHistory.)

Returns — std::vector<EquityPoint>, each:

Field Type Description time int64_t Point time, unix sec (UTC) balance / equity double Balance / equity at the point realizedPL / unrealizedPL double Realized / floating P/L cashFlow double Deposit/withdrawal at the point balanceDrawdownRaw / equityDrawdownRaw double Drawdowns (money) 
auto curve = svc.equityHistory();
double peak = 0, maxDD = 0;
for (const auto& p : curve) { peak = std::max(peak, p.equity); maxDD = std::max(maxDD, peak - p.equity); }
std::printf("%zu points, max DD %.2f\n", curve.size(), maxDD);

docs.title: tradeUnrealizedPL()
docs.text:
std::vector<UnrealizedExtremum> tradeUnrealizedPL();

The max/min floating P/L (MFE/MAE) reached per currently open order. (Low-level: TradeUnrealizedPL.)

Returns — std::vector<UnrealizedExtremum>, each:

Field Type Description ticket int64_t Order ticket symbol std::string Instrument maxPL / maxTime double / int64_t Best floating profit (MFE) + when minPL / minTime double / int64_t Worst floating P/L (MAE) + when 
for (const auto& e : svc.tradeUnrealizedPL())
    std::printf("#%lld %-8s MFE %.2f MAE %.2f\n",
                (long long)e.ticket, e.symbol.c_str(), e.maxPL, e.minPL);

The facade does not wrap tradeStatsEquityHistory (stats+curve+trades in one call) — use account().tradeStatsEquityHistory(...) on the low-level layer if you need the combined payload.

Back to: MT4Service — Overview · Next: 2. Orders & History

docs.title: MT4Service — 2. Orders & History
docs.text:
Live orders and closed history as friendly structs. MT4 has no "positions" — market and pending orders share one Order list; tell them apart with isPending() / isBuy().

MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

docs.title: openedOrders() / openedOrders(magic)
docs.text:
std::vector<Order> openedOrders();
std::vector<Order> openedOrders(int32_t magic);   // filtered by magic number

All live orders (market and pending), optionally filtered by magic number. (Low-level: OpenedOrders.)

Returns — std::vector<Order>, each:

Field Type Description ticket int32_t Order ticket symbol std::string Instrument type OrderType Buy/Sell (market) or *Limit/*Stop (pending) lots double Volume openPrice double Entry / trigger price stopLoss / takeProfit double SL / TP (0 = none) profit / swap / commission double Floating P/L / swap / commission magic int32_t Strategy tag comment std::string Order comment openTime / expirationTime int64_t Open / pending expiry, unix sec (UTC); expiry 0 = GTC

Helpers: o.isPending() (pending vs market), o.isBuy() (buy-side).

for (const auto& o : svc.openedOrders())
    std::printf("#%d %-8s %s %.2f  P/L %.2f\n",
                o.ticket, o.symbol.c_str(), o.isPending() ? "PENDING" : "MARKET", o.lots, o.profit);

// only this strategy's orders
auto mine = svc.openedOrders(/*magic*/ 777);

docs.title: openedOrdersTickets()
docs.text:
std::vector<int32_t> openedOrdersTickets();

Just the ticket numbers of all live orders — the lightweight poll. (Low-level: OpenedOrdersTickets.)

auto tickets = svc.openedOrdersTickets();
std::printf("%zu open orders\n", tickets.size());

docs.title: ordersHistory(fromUnix, toUnix)
docs.text:
std::vector<HistoryOrder> ordersHistory(int64_t fromUnix, int64_t toUnix);

Closed orders in a UTC window (unix seconds). (Low-level: OrdersHistory.)

Returns — std::vector<HistoryOrder>, each: the Order fields plus closePrice and closeTime (unix sec, UTC).

#include <ctime>
int64_t now = (int64_t)std::time(nullptr);
auto hist = svc.ordersHistory(now - 7*24*3600, now);     // last 7 days

double realized = 0;
for (const auto& h : hist) {
    if (h.type == OrderType::Balance || h.type == OrderType::Credit) continue;  // skip non-trades
    realized += h.profit + h.swap + h.commission;
}
std::printf("%zu closed, realized %.2f\n", hist.size(), realized);

Filter out OrderType::Balance / OrderType::Credit — they're deposits/credits, not trades.

Back to: MT4Service — Overview · Next: 3. Symbols & Quotes

docs.title: MT4Service — 3. Symbols & Quotes
docs.text:
Prices, the symbol inventory, parameters, tick value, bars — and the time helpers — as friendly structs, times in UTC.

MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

docs.title: quote(symbol) / quoteMany(symbols)
docs.text:
Quote quote(const std::string& symbol);
std::vector<Quote> quoteMany(const std::vector<std::string>& symbols);

Latest price(s). (Low-level: Quote · QuoteMany.)

Returns — Quote:

Field Type Description symbol std::string Instrument time int64_t Quote time, unix sec (UTC) bid / ask double Current prices high / low double Session high / low

Helper: q.twoSided() (bid & ask valid). (No last/volume on quotes — those come from ticks; see 5. Streaming.)

Quote q = svc.quote("EURUSD");
std::printf("%s %.5f / %.5f\n", q.symbol.c_str(), q.bid, q.ask);

for (const auto& x : svc.quoteMany({"EURUSD","GBPUSD","XAUUSD"}))
    std::printf("  %-8s %.5f\n", x.symbol.c_str(), x.bid);

docs.title: symbolSelect(symbol, select=true)
docs.text:
bool symbolSelect(const std::string& symbol, bool select = true);

Add/remove a symbol from Market Watch — required before a symbol quotes or trades. Returns success. (Low-level: SymbolSelect.)

if (svc.symbolSelect("XAUUSD")) { /* now safe to quote/trade */ }

docs.title: symbolList()
docs.text:
std::vector<std::string> symbolList();

Every symbol name the broker offers. (Low-level: Symbols.)

auto names = svc.symbolList();
std::printf("%zu symbols\n", names.size());

docs.title: symbolParams(symbol) / symbolParamsMany(nameFilter="")
docs.text:
SymbolInfo symbolParams(const std::string& symbol);
std::vector<SymbolInfo> symbolParamsMany(const std::string& nameFilter = "");

Full contract spec (the useful subset of ~70 fields). symbolParamsMany("") returns all symbols. (Low-level: SymbolParamsMany.)

Returns — SymbolInfo (key fields):

Field Type Description name / description / path std::string Identity digits / point int / double Price precision contractSize double e.g. 100000 for FX tickValue / tickSize double P&L inputs volumeMin / volumeMax / volumeStep double Volume grid stopsLevel / freezeLevel int Min SL/TP & freeze distance (points) tradeMode int 0 DISABLED…4 FULL marginInitial double Margin per lot currencyBase / currencyProfit / currencyMargin std::string Currencies swapLong / swapShort double Swaps selected / visible bool In Market Watch / visible 
SymbolInfo s = svc.symbolParams("EURUSD");
double pip = (s.digits == 3 || s.digits == 5) ? s.point * 10 : s.point;
std::printf("%s digits=%d pip=%.5f contract=%.0f\n", s.name.c_str(), s.digits, pip, s.contractSize);

docs.title: tickValueWithSize(symbols)
docs.text:
std::vector<TickValueSize> tickValueWithSize(const std::vector<std::string>& symbols);

Tick value / tick size / contract size per symbol — the inputs for client-side P&L and sizing (MT4 has no server calculator). (Low-level: TickValueWithSize.)

Returns — std::vector<TickValueSize>, each: symbol, tickValue, tickSize, contractSize.

for (const auto& t : svc.tickValueWithSize({"EURUSD","XAUUSD"}))
    std::printf("%-8s tickVal %.5f size %.5f\n", t.symbol.c_str(), t.tickValue, t.tickSize);

docs.title: bars(symbol, tf, fromUnix, toUnix, maxBars=0) / lastBars(symbol, tf, count)
docs.text:
std::vector<Bar> bars(const std::string& symbol, Timeframe tf,
                      int64_t fromUnix, int64_t toUnix, int maxBars = 0);
std::vector<Bar> lastBars(const std::string& symbol, Timeframe tf, int count);

OHLC bars over a UTC window, or the newest count bars. Timeframe values are minutes (M1=1 … H1=60 … D1=1440). lastBars supplies the required from_time for you. (Low-level: Bars.)

Returns — std::vector<Bar>, each: time (unix sec, UTC), open, high, low, close, tickVolume, realVolume, spread.

auto bars = svc.lastBars("EURUSD", Timeframe::H1, 100);   // newest 100 H1 bars
if (!bars.empty())
    std::printf("last close %.5f\n", bars.back().close);

🆚 bars uses the minute-count timeframe scheme; the low-level quoteHistory uses a different index enum. The facade standardizes on Timeframe (minutes).

docs.title: Time helpers
docs.text:
int64_t serverOffsetSeconds();        // broker clock minus UTC (seconds), cached
int64_t toUtc(int64_t serverTime);    // raw broker time -> UTC
int64_t toServerTime(int64_t utc);    // UTC -> raw broker time
ServerTimezoneInfo serverTimezone();  // name, offset, source, validated-at

(Low-level: ServerTimezone.)

Returns — ServerTimezoneInfo: server, utcOffsetSeconds, source, validatedUtc.

ServerTimezoneInfo tz = svc.serverTimezone();
std::printf("%s  UTC%+d h\n", tz.server.c_str(), tz.utcOffsetSeconds / 3600);

Back to: MT4Service — Overview · Next: 4. Trading Operations

docs.title: MT4Service — 4. Trading Operations
docs.text:
Place, modify, close and net orders with plain arguments. The facade builds the request and casts enums; a OrderRequest struct carries everything orderSend needs.

🛑 Still no retcode. A rejected trade throws metarpc::ApiError (MQL4 code in mqlErrorCode) — orderSend / orderClose / orderCloseBy surface the throw. orderModify returns a bool. Wrap trades in try/catch (const ApiError&). See the low-level Trading Operations overview for the MQL4 code table.

MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

docs.title: orderSend(OrderRequest)
docs.text:
OrderResult orderSend(const OrderRequest& request);

Place a market or pending order. (Low-level: OrderSend.)

Input — OrderRequest:

Field Type Description symbol std::string Instrument type OrderType Buy/Sell (market) or *Limit/*Stop (pending) volume double Lots price double 0 = market for Buy/Sell; required for pendings stopLoss / takeProfit double SL / TP prices (0 = none) slippage int Max deviation (points), default 10 magic int32_t Strategy tag comment std::string Order comment expiration int64_t Pending expiry, unix sec (UTC); 0 = GTC

Returns — OrderResult: ticket, volume (filled), price (fill), openTime; ok() = ticket != 0.

OrderRequest req;
req.symbol = "EURUSD";
req.type   = OrderType::Buy;
req.volume = 0.10;
req.stopLoss = 1.09500;  req.takeProfit = 1.10500;   // prices
try {
    OrderResult r = svc.orderSend(req);
    std::printf("opened #%d @ %.5f\n", r.ticket, r.price);
} catch (const ApiError& e) {
    std::printf("rejected: %s (MQL4 %d)\n", e.what(), e.mqlErrorCode);
}

docs.title: orderModify(ticket, sl, tp, price=0, expiration=0)
docs.text:
bool orderModify(int32_t ticket, double stopLoss, double takeProfit,
                 double price = 0, int64_t expiration = 0);

Change SL/TP (and price/expiration for pendings). Returns whether the terminal applied the change (and returns false instead of throwing on an ordinary rejection). (Low-level: OrderModify.)

if (svc.orderModify(ticket, /*sl*/ 1.09000, /*tp*/ 1.11000))
    std::puts("SL/TP updated");

docs.title: orderClose(ticket, lots=0, price=0, slippage=10)
docs.text:
void orderClose(int32_t ticket, double lots = 0, double price = 0, int slippage = 10);

Close a market order (lots = 0 → the whole order; a smaller value → partial) or delete a pending order. (Low-level: OrderCloseDelete.)

try { svc.orderClose(ticket); }                 // full close / delete
catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("close failed: %s\n", e.what()); }

svc.orderClose(ticket, /*lots*/ 0.05);          // partial close

docs.title: orderCloseBy(ticket, oppositeTicket)
docs.text:
CloseByResult orderCloseBy(int32_t ticket, int32_t oppositeTicket);

Close an order against an opposite order on the same symbol (netting a hedge). (Low-level: OrderCloseBy.)

Returns — CloseByResult: closePrice, profit, closeTime (unix sec, UTC).

try {
    CloseByResult r = svc.orderCloseBy(buyTicket, sellTicket);
    std::printf("netted @ %.5f  profit %.2f\n", r.closePrice, r.profit);
} catch (const ApiError& e) { std::printf("close-by failed: %s\n", e.what()); }

Sizing & validation live one layer up (MT4Sugar) or you build it from symbolParams + tickValueWithSize — MT4 has no server-side orderCheck / orderCalc*.

Back to: MT4Service — Overview · Next: 5. Streaming Methods

docs.title: MT4Service — 5. Streaming Methods
docs.text:
Real-time streams delivering friendly structs (times in UTC) to your callback on a background thread. Each returns a std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> — keep it alive to keep receiving; stop() / destroy to cancel.

class ServiceStream {
    void stop();                    // cancel + join the reader thread
    bool running() const;           // false once ended/cancelled
    uint64_t count() const;         // payloads delivered so far
    std::string lastError() const;  // reason it ended, or "" if clean
};

Thread safety: the callback runs on another thread — synchronize shared state and keep it short. (Low-level: Streaming Methods overview.)

MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");

docs.title: subscribeTicks(symbols, cb)
docs.text:
std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> subscribeTicks(
    const std::vector<std::string>& symbols, std::function<void(const Tick&)> callback);

Live ticks for the given symbols. (Low-level: OnSymbolTick.)

Delivers — Tick: symbol, time (unix sec, UTC), timeMsc, bid, ask, last, volume. (Unlike the unary quote, ticks carry last and volume.)

auto s = svc.subscribeTicks({"EURUSD"}, [](const Tick& t) {
    std::printf("%s %.5f/%.5f last %.5f vol %llu\n",
                t.symbol.c_str(), t.bid, t.ask, t.last, (unsigned long long)t.volume);
});
std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(5));
s->stop();

docs.title: streamTradeUpdates(cb)
docs.text:
std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> streamTradeUpdates(std::function<void(const TradeEvent&)> callback);

Order lifecycle events — opened / changed / closed / new-history. (Low-level: OnTrade.)

Delivers — TradeEvent:

Field Type Description type int Event group (OrderProfit / OrderUpdate) account EventAccountInfo Account snapshot (balance/equity/margin/profit/…) newOrders std::vector<TradeOrderInfo> Just appeared updatedOrders std::vector<OrderChange> {previous, current} pairs removedOrders std::vector<TradeOrderInfo> Removed / closed newHistoryOrders std::vector<TradeOrderInfo> Landed in history 
auto s = svc.streamTradeUpdates([](const TradeEvent& e) {
    for (const auto& o : e.newOrders)     std::printf("+ #%d %s\n", o.ticket, o.symbol.c_str());
    for (const auto& o : e.removedOrders) std::printf("- #%d profit %.2f\n", o.ticket, o.profit);
});

docs.title: streamOrderProfits(cb, periodMs=1000)
docs.text:
std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> streamOrderProfits(
    std::function<void(const OrderProfitEvent&)> callback, int periodMs = 1000);

Periodic floating-P/L snapshots of the open orders (server timer). (Low-level: OnOpenedOrdersProfit.)

Delivers — OrderProfitEvent: type, account (EventAccountInfo), orders (std::vector<OrderProfitInfo>: ticket, symbol, type, lots, openPrice, profit, swap, commission, …).

auto s = svc.streamOrderProfits([](const OrderProfitEvent& e) {
    double total = 0; for (const auto& o : e.orders) total += o.profit;
    std::printf("\rFloating P/L %.2f (%zu orders)", total, e.orders.size());
    std::fflush(stdout);
}, /*periodMs*/ 500);

docs.title: streamOpenedTickets(cb, intervalMs=1000)
docs.text:
std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> streamOpenedTickets(
    std::function<void(const TicketsSnapshot&)> callback, int intervalMs = 1000);

Periodic ticket snapshots — market vs pending, split. (Low-level: OnOpenedOrdersTickets.)

Delivers — TicketsSnapshot: positionTickets (market), pendingOrderTickets, serverTime (unix sec, UTC), terminalGuid.

auto s = svc.streamOpenedTickets([](const TicketsSnapshot& t) {
    std::printf("\rmarket %zu  pending %zu",
                t.positionTickets.size(), t.pendingOrderTickets.size());
    std::fflush(stdout);
});

docs.title: streamConnectState(cb)
docs.text:
std::unique_ptr<ServiceStream> streamConnectState(std::function<void(const ConnectState&)> callback);

Terminal connection-state changes. (Low-level: OnConnectState.)

Delivers — ConnectState: id, state, isConnected, isAlive, apiIsAlive, server, account, errorMessage, timestamp (unix sec, UTC).

std::atomic<bool> healthy{true};
auto s = svc.streamConnectState([&](const ConnectState& st) {
    healthy = st.isConnected && st.isAlive && st.apiIsAlive;
    if (!healthy) std::printf("⚠️ link down: %s\n", st.errorMessage.c_str());
});

Back to: MT4Service — Overview · Up: MT4Sugar

docs.title: MT4Service — Mid-Level Facade (Layer 2 of 3)
docs.text:
The friendly facade over MT4Account: the same operations, but you pass plain arguments (std::string symbols, tickets, typed enums) and get back clean C++ structs — no protobuf — with times already in UTC.

Defined in include/metarpc/mt4_service.hpp + src/mt4_service.cpp. The header is protobuf-free (it forward-declares MT4Account), so strategy code that includes it compiles fast.

MT4Sugar (HIGH)    one-liners, pip math, risk sizing
   │ owns
MT4Service (MID)   ← you are here — friendly args, clean structs, UTC
   │ owns
MT4Account (LOW)   raw gRPC, protobuf *Data payloads

Each MT4Service owns one MT4Account. Reach the raw layer any time via service.account() for a field the facade doesn't surface.

docs.title: What the facade adds
docs.text:
• Friendly arguments — build the *Request and cast enums for you (quote("EURUSD"), orderModify(ticket, sl, tp)).
  • Clean returns — simple structs (AccountInfo, Quote, Order, Bar, …) instead of protobuf getters; std::vector<…> instead of repeated fields.
  • UTC by default — every time returned is UTC and every time you pass in is treated as UTC. Construct with utcTimes = false to work in raw broker-server time.
  • Same error model — a server rejection throws metarpc::ApiError, a transport failure throws metarpc::TransportError. (Trades still have no retcode — see Trading.)

Field tables live in MT4Account. Each struct below mirrors a protobuf *Data; for the full per-field proto detail, follow the links to the matching MT4Account method page.

docs.title: Construction & connection
docs.text:
#include <metarpc/mt4_service.hpp>
using namespace metarpc;

// host/port/apiKey/name as MT4Account; utcTimes defaults to true
MT4Service svc("mt4.mrpc.pro", 443);
svc.connect(1235959737, "password", "EGlobal-Demo");   // ConnectEx, blocks until ready

AccountInfo a = svc.accountSummary();
std::printf("Equity %.2f %s\n", a.equity, a.currency.c_str());
Method Purpose connect(login, password, server, name="", timeoutSeconds=120) ConnectEx by broker server name; stores creds for auto-reconnect reconnect() / isConnected() / terminalGuid() re-issue ConnectEx / state / terminal id disconnect(reason="") Disconnect RPC — stops the terminal on the gateway close() drop the local channel only; the terminal keeps running options() mutable ClientOptions (deadlines, retries) account() the underlying MT4Account, for raw RPCs not surfaced here

docs.title: Section pages
docs.text:
• 1. Account Information — summary + trade stats / equity curve / unrealized-P&L extrema.
  • 2. Orders & History — open orders, tickets, closed history.
  • 3. Symbols & Quotes — quotes, symbols, params, tick value, bars, and time helpers.
  • 4. Trading Operations — send / modify / close / close-by.
  • 5. Streaming Methods — ticks, trades, order-profit, ticket snapshots, connect state.
